lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
lsp.judge: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my multiple letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that in Turkey, since October 20, that is, for months, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on a hunger strike, risking death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot implement its plan to lock them up in white single cells and thus break their morale and resistance.
lsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my multiple written submissions to you, I would like to draw your attention once again today to the fact that in Turkey, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike since October 20, putting their lives at risk - some of them have already died - in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, der Schutz des kulturellen und natürlichen Erbes ist meiner Ansicht nach neben der Frage, wer im Sinne des Vertrags wofür verantwortlich ist, eine für alle wichtige Angelegenheit. Denn - und erlauben Sie mir, dies zu sagen, bevor ich zum Kern des Themas komme - für mich kann das Kulturerbe, das - und darin stimme ich mit Ihnen überein - aus Gebäuden, Naturdenkmälern und Traditionen besteht, nicht auf eine Person, eine Region oder ein Land begrenzt werden, da es der gesamten Gemeinschaft der europäischen Bürger gehört.
lsp.judge: Mr President, the protection of cultural and natural heritage is, in my view, an important matter for all of us, alongside the question of who is responsible for what in the sense of the Treaty. For – and allow me to say this before I come to the heart of the matter – in my view, cultural heritage, which – and I agree with you on this – consists of buildings, natural monuments and traditions, cannot be limited to one person, one region or one country, since it belongs to the entire community of European citizens.

lsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
lsp.judge: It has been proven that it was right to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had moved it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even one euro there.

lsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
lsp.judge: (ES) My support for the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union which, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to the fore the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements which constitute our common cultural heritage.
lsp.proxy: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

lsp.query: Deshalb bestehe ich darauf, im Rahmen dieser Vereinfachung und Verbesserung der gemeinschaftlichen Rechtsvorschriften im Hinblick auf die in diesem Bericht erwähnte Koordinierung der sozialen Sicherheit zu berücksichtigen, dass es angebracht wäre, wenn ein Arbeitnehmer, der in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union beschäftigt war, seine Rente nicht "häppchenweise " in verschiedenen Staaten, sondern von einer einzigen Rentenzahlstelle erhielte.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I insist that, in the context of this simplification and improvement of Community legislation with regard to the coordination of social security referred to in this report, it would be appropriate for a worker who has been employed in several Member States of the European Union to receive his pension not in "bits and pieces" in various states, but from a single pension payment agency.
lsp.proxy: Therefore, I insist that, in the context of this simplification and improvement of the community regulations regarding the coordination of social security mentioned in this report, it would be appropriate for an employee who has been employed in several member states of the European Union to receive their pension not "piecemeal" in various states, but from a single pension payment office.
lsp.reference: I therefore insist that, within the framework of this simplification and improvement of the Community's legal provisions with regard to the coordination of social security mentioned in this report, it would be appropriate to consider that a worker who has been employed in several Member States of the European Union should receive his pension not "piecemeal" in various countries, but from a single pension payment office.

lsp.query: Jetzt wurde eine Brücke zwischen Kopenhagen und Malmö gebaut, und es wird damit gerechnet, dass die grenzüberschreitende Beschäftigung weiter ansteigen wird und beide Städte zu einer Großstadtregion verschmelzen werden. Auf Initiative der Dänen wurde hier 1997 der von der EU unterstützte Grundsatz der Besteuerung im Beschäftigungsland eingeführt.
lsp.judge: Now a bridge has been built between Copenhagen and Malmö, and it is expected that cross-border employment will continue to increase and both cities will merge into a metropolitan region. At the initiative of the Danes, the EU-supported principle of taxation in the country of employment was introduced here in 1997.

lsp.query: Wenn es lediglich darum gegangen wäre, zu überwachen, dass die EU-Mittel nicht zur Finanzierung von Projekten verwendet werden, die zur Zerstörung dieser besonderen Ökosysteme beitragen, so hätte ich diesen Text akzeptiert und dafür gestimmt, aber es ist inakzeptabel und beispiellos, dass eine Unionspolitik von der Einhaltung einer anderen abhängig gemacht wird und dass ein Umweltkriterium beispielsweise gegenüber einem sozialen Kriterium Vorrang haben soll.
lsp.judge: If it had been merely a matter of monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted in favour of it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that one Union policy should be made conditional on compliance with another and that an environmental criterion, for example, should take precedence over a social criterion.
lsp.proxy: If it had merely been a matter of ensuring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these unique ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on the observance of another and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.

lsp.query: Der Vorschlag für eine Verordnung zur Schaffung der Sonderfazilität für Kriseneinsätze ist nichts anderes als der Rahmen für zwar nichtmilitärische, aber nichtsdestoweniger imperialistische politische und wirtschaftliche Interventionen in jedem beliebigen Teil der Welt. Was die führenden Kreise der EU anstreben, ist ein Mechanismus zur sofortigen Mobilisierung von Human- und Finanzressourcen, der rasch eingesetzt werden kann, und zwar nicht nur in "Krisensituationen " (vielleicht könnten uns die Verfasser des Textes einmal sagen, welche Merkmale eine "Krisensituation " kennzeichnen), sondern auch dann, wenn lediglich eine Bedrohung oder selbst nur eine Beeinträchtigung der so genannten Unterstützungs- und Kooperationsprogramme mit diesen Ländern zu befürchten ist.
lsp.judge: The proposal for a regulation establishing the crisis response facility is nothing other than a framework for non-military, but nonetheless imperialist political and economic intervention in any part of the world. What the EU's leading circles are seeking is a mechanism for the immediate mobilisation of human and financial resources which can be deployed rapidly, not only in 'crisis situations' (perhaps the authors of the text could tell us what the characteristics of a 'crisis situation' are), but also when there is merely a threat or even just a hindrance to the so-called support and cooperation programmes with these countries.
lsp.proxy: The proposal for a regulation to establish a special facility for crisis interventions is nothing other than the framework for non-military, yet nonetheless imperialist, political and economic interventions in any part of the world. What the leading circles of the EU aim for is a mechanism for the immediate mobilization of human and financial resources, which can be quickly deployed, not only in "crisis situations" (perhaps the authors of this text could tell us which characteristics define a "crisis situation"), but also when merely a threat or even a disruption of the so-called support and cooperation programs with these countries is to be feared.

lsp.query: Vor allem für die Angehörigen der Opfer ist es nämlich unerträglich, dass noch keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen verübten Verbrechen bestraft worden ist und die Hauptschuldigen am Genozid völlig unbehelligt in Kambodscha leben, ganz zu schweigen von der Beteiligung ehemaliger Roter Khmer an der Regierung.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, the older among us have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital, because the Khmer Rouge, whose leaders were trained in the precepts of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.

lsp.query: Ein Politiker, der vor kurzem gestorben ist, Son San, ein Demokrat, der den schweren Weg zwischen den Roten Khmer auf der einen Seite und dem pro-vietnamesischen Marionettenregime auf der anderen Seite gegangen ist, hat vor allem mit Hilfe der EU und des Europäischen Parlaments Schritt für Schritt die Wiederherstellung eines demokratischen Kambodscha vorangetrieben.
lsp.judge: A politician who recently died, Son San, a democrat who walked the difficult path between the Khmer Rouge on the one hand and the pro-Vietnamese puppet regime on the other, has above all, with the help of the EU and the European Parliament, step by step promoted the restoration of a democratic Cambodia.

ilsp.reference: Madam President, I would like to draw your attention and that of my fellow Members to the fact that, although I am aware of the reasons that led you to overload the agenda for Wednesday in this way, as regards the political issues to be discussed, the Council and the Commission have the same speaking time as all the Members of the European Parliament put together: 90 minutes for the Council and the Commission, 90 minutes for the Members.

ilsp.query: Meiner Ansicht nach können wir nicht auf der einen Seite die Vollbeschäftigung zu einer Aktionspriorität der Europäischen Union erheben und uns mit der Ausarbeitung eines Statuts der Europäischen Aktiengesellschaft beschäftigen, das neue Rechte für Arbeitnehmer vorsieht, und auf der anderen Seite passiv eine derartige Strategie hinnehmen, die den Gesetzen der Aktienmärkte Vorrang vor allen anderen Erwägungen einräumt.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, we cannot on the one hand make full employment a priority action of the European Union and be concerned with drawing up a statute for the European company which provides new rights for workers, and on the other hand passively accept such a strategy which gives priority to the laws of the stock markets over all other considerations.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, we cannot elevate full employment to a priority of the European Union on one side and engage in drafting a statute for the European Company that provides new rights for employees, while passively accepting a strategy on the other side that gives precedence to the laws of the stock markets over all other considerations.
ilsp.reference: In my view, we cannot on the one hand make full employment a priority action of the European Union and work on a statute for the European company which provides new rights for employees, and on the other hand passively accept a strategy which gives precedence to the laws of the stock market over all other considerations.

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Meine Fraktion wird diesem Vorschlag zustimmen, weil wir genau die Ansichten von Herrn Wurtz teilen, dass es sich hierbei wegen der Bedeutung der Danone-Firmengruppe und der Auswirkungen der vorgeschlagenen Maßnahmen auf mehrere Länder nicht um eine rein französische, sondern um eine europäische Angelegenheit handelt.
ilsp.judge: Madam President! My group will agree to this proposal because we share exactly the views of Mr Wurtz that this is not a purely French, but a European matter because of the importance of the Danone group of companies and the impact of the proposed measures on several countries.
ilsp.proxy: Madam President! My faction will support this proposal because we exactly share the views of Mr. Wurtz that, due to the importance of the Danone Group and the effects of the proposed measures on several countries, this is not a purely French, but a European matter.
ilsp.reference: Madam President! My group will agree to this proposal because we share exactly the views of Mr Wurtz that, given the importance of the Danone group and the impact of the proposed measures on several countries, this is not a purely French but a European matter.

ilsp.query: Zudem lehnt es Herr Denktasch, der Führer "Nord-Zyperns ", das - nur zur Erinnerung - unter türkischer Besatzung steht, ab, an weiteren Gesprächen zur Lösung des Zypernproblems teilzunehmen. Offensichtlich fühlt er sich weitaus stärker als je zuvor, nachdem die Europäische Union die Türkei ohne langes Nachdenken, wie ich meine, in den Kreis der EU-Beitrittskandidaten aufgenommen hat.
ilsp.judge: In addition, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "Northern Cyprus", which - just to remind you - is under Turkish occupation, refuses to participate in further talks to resolve the Cyprus problem. Apparently, he feels much stronger than ever before, after the European Union has taken Turkey into the circle of EU accession candidates without much thought, as I think.
ilsp.proxy: In addition, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "Northern Cyprus", which is under Turkish occupation, as a reminder, rejects participating in further talks to solve the Cyprus problem. It is obvious that he feels much stronger than ever before, after the European Union has taken Turkey into the circle of EU accession candidates without much thought, as I mean.
ilsp.reference: Furthermore, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "Northern Cyprus", which - just for the record - is under Turkish occupation, refuses to participate in further talks to resolve the Cyprus problem. Apparently, he feels much stronger than ever before, after the European Union, in my opinion, has taken Turkey into the circle of EU accession candidates without much deliberation.

ilsp.query: Faktisch soll diese Richtlinie Sicherheit hinsichtlich der Vorschriften bieten, die kohärente und sektorspezifische Regelungen für die Institute, die Aktiva, die Rechte und die geschäftlichen Beziehungen vorsehen, falls eine in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Union tätige Bank in Schwierigkeiten gerät oder Konkurs anmelden muss.
ilsp.judge: In fact, this directive is intended to provide security with regard to the regulations that provide coherent and sector-specific regulations for the institutions, assets, rights and business relationships in the event that a bank operating in several Member States of the Union gets into difficulties or has to file for bankruptcy.
ilsp.proxy: In substance, this guideline is intended to provide security with regard to the rules that provide for coherent and sector-specific regulations for institutions, assets, rights, and business relationships, in the event that a bank active in several member states of the Union encounters difficulties or is forced to file for bankruptcy.
ilsp.reference: In practice, this directive is intended to provide security with regard to the provisions that provide coherent and sector-specific rules for institutions, assets, rights, and business relationships in the event that a bank operating in several Member States of the Union encounters difficulties or is required to file for bankruptcy.

ilsp.query: In seinem mit qualifizierter Mehrheit angenommenen Gemeinsamen Standpunkt beweist der Rat ein feines und sicheres Gespür für die Eigenheiten des Banksektors, die ihn sowohl hinsichtlich des Insolvenzverfahrens generell als auch eines Vergleichs mit den anderen Finanzsektoren, wie dem Versicherungswesen und dem Wertpapierhandel, eine Sonderstellung einnehmen lassen.
ilsp.judge: In its common position adopted by qualified majority, the Council shows a fine and safe sense of the peculiarities of the banking sector, which make it a special case both in terms of insolvency proceedings in general and in comparison with the other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading.
ilsp.proxy: In its Common Position adopted by a qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the idiosyncrasies of the banking sector, which, in general terms, as well as in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading, entitles it to a special position in the context of insolvency proceedings.
ilsp.reference: In its common position adopted by qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the specific characteristics of the banking sector, which give it a special position both in terms of insolvency proceedings in general and in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading.

ilsp.query: In dem Bericht von Frau Peijs - zu dem ich ihr im Namen der Kommission gratulieren möchte, wobei ich mich den Komplimenten von Frau Villiers und Herrn Skinner gern anschließe -, der weitestgehend positiv zu dem Gemeinsamen Standpunkt steht, werden - wie heute Abend bereits erwähnt - mehrere Änderungsanträge zu Artikel 20 vorgeschlagen.
ilsp.judge: In Mrs Peijs' report - which I would like to congratulate her on behalf of the Commission, joining Mrs Villiers and Mr Skinner in their compliments - which is largely positive about the common position, several amendments are proposed to Article 20 - as has already been mentioned this evening.
ilsp.proxy: In the report by Mrs. Peijs - to which I would like to extend my congratulations on behalf of the Commission, where I gladly join in the compliments from Mrs. Villiers and Mr. Skinner -, which largely stands in a positive view to the Common Position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed - as already mentioned this evening -.
ilsp.reference: In the report by Mrs Peijs - to which I would like to offer my congratulations on behalf of the Commission, while associating myself with the compliments paid by Mrs Villiers and Mr Skinner -, which is largely positive with regard to the common position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed, as mentioned this evening.

ilsp.query: Es fällt mir auf, dass von den Bildungsträgern auch der Mangel an Mitteln beklagt wird, denn wir wünschen nicht nur, dass unsere Kinder in der Schule gut lernen, wir wollen auch, dass diese Schule angemessen ausgestattet ist und eine sichere Stätte darstellt, mit anderen Worten, dass die Infrastruktur ebenfalls ein hohes Niveau aufweist.
ilsp.judge: I notice that the lack of resources is also complained about by the training providers, because we do not only wish that our children learn well at school, we also want this school to be adequately equipped and to be a safe place, in other words, that the infrastructure also has a high level.
ilsp.proxy: It catches my attention that the lack of resources is also being complained about by the educational institutions, because we don't just wish for our children to learn well in school, we also want the school to be adequately equipped and to represent a safe environment, in other words, for the infrastructure to also have a high level as well.
ilsp.reference: I notice that educational institutions also lament the lack of resources, because we not only wish for our children to learn well in school, but also want this school to be properly equipped and be a safe place, in other words, that the infrastructure also meets a high standard.

ilsp.query: Der Übergang zur Wissensgesellschaft, die Globalisierung der Wirtschaft, der soziale, demokratische und ökologische Wandel sowie tiefgreifende Veränderungen in der Arbeitswelt, nicht zuletzt durch die neuen Technologien, das sind die großen Herausforderungen im dritten Jahrtausend, die auch neue Anstrengungen im Bildungsbereich erfordern.
ilsp.judge: The transition to the knowledge society, the globalization of the economy, the social, democratic and ecological change as well as profound changes in the world of work, not least through the new technologies, these are the great challenges in the third millennium, which also require new efforts in the field of education.
ilsp.proxy: The transition to a knowledge society, the globalization of the economy, social, democratic, and ecological change, as well as profound changes in the world of work, not least due to new technologies, are the major challenges of the third millennium, which also require new efforts in the field of education.
ilsp.reference: The transition to a knowledge-based society, the globalization of the economy, social, democratic, and ecological change, as well as profound changes in the world of work, not least due to new technologies, are the major challenges of the third millennium, which also require new efforts in the field of education.

ilsp.query: Daher befürworte ich ganz besonders die Ziffern des Entschließungsantrags, in denen die Kommission aufgefordert wird, vor jeder Projektfinanzierung etwaige Auswirkungen auf das kulturelle und natürliche Erbe, die historische Bedeutung und die zu erhaltende Ästhetik zu prüfen, denn diese sollten gleichermaßen als Kriterien für die Billigung von Projekten herangezogen werden.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, I particularly support the figures of the resolution, in which the Commission is called upon to examine any impact on cultural and natural heritage, historical significance and the aesthetics to be preserved before any project financing, as these should be used equally as criteria for the approval of projects.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, I particularly advocate for the provisions of the resolution proposal, in which the Commission is called upon to examine the potential impacts on cultural and natural heritage, historical significance, and the aesthetic to be preserved before any project financing, because these should be used equally as criteria for the approval of projects.
ilsp.reference: I therefore particularly endorse the figures in the resolution which call on the Commission, before financing any project, to examine the potential impact on cultural and natural heritage, historical significance and the aesthetic value to be preserved, as these should also be used as criteria for the approval of projects.

ilsp.query: Darüber hinaus möchte ich darauf hinweisen, dass wir im Rahmen unserer Programme Raphael und Kultur 2000 nachdrücklich und unterschiedslos alle Bürger, Regionen, Staaten und Verbände, alle diejenigen unterstützen, die sich vor Ort darum bemühen, das gemeinsame Kulturerbe aller europäischen Bürger zu bewahren.
ilsp.judge: In addition, I would like to point out that, within the framework of our programmes Raphael and Culture 2000, we are strongly and indiscriminately supporting all citizens, regions, states and associations, all those who are striving on the ground to preserve the common cultural heritage of all European citizens.
ilsp.proxy: In addition, I would like to emphasize that within the framework of our programs Raphael and Kultur 2000, we strongly and impartially support all citizens, regions, states, and associations, all those who are making an effort locally to preserve the common cultural heritage of all European citizens.
ilsp.reference: Furthermore, I would like to point out that, within the framework of our programmes Raphael and Culture 2000, we are actively and indiscriminately supporting all citizens, regions, states and associations, all those who are endeavouring locally to preserve the common cultural heritage of all European citizens.

ilsp.query: Sie sollen allen Bürgern als Beispiel dienen, dass es, manchmal auch mit geringen Mitteln, möglich ist, sich für den Erhalt unser aller Kulturerbe, ob es dem Einzelnen nun direkt oder indirekt gehört, also für den Erhalt des Kulturerbes aller Europäer für die nachkommenden Generationen unter Berücksichtigung der kulturellen Vielfalt einzusetzen.
ilsp.judge: They are to serve as an example to all citizens that it is possible, sometimes with limited means, to work for the preservation of our cultural heritage, whether it belongs directly or indirectly to the individual, that is, for the preservation of the cultural heritage of all Europeans for future generations, taking into account cultural diversity.
ilsp.proxy: They are meant to serve as an example to all citizens, that it is sometimes possible, even with limited means, to use oneself for the preservation of our common cultural heritage, whether it belongs directly or indirectly to the individual, thus for the preservation of the cultural heritage of all Europeans for future generations, taking into account the cultural diversity.
ilsp.reference: They are to serve as an example to all citizens that it is possible, sometimes with limited means, to work towards preserving our shared cultural heritage, whether it directly or indirectly belongs to the individual, thus preserving the cultural heritage of all Europeans for future generations, taking into account cultural diversity.

ilsp.judge: The agenda is followed by the report by Mrs van der Laan (A5-0397/2000) on behalf of the Committee on Budgetary Control on the Commission report on the measures taken in the light of the European Parliament's observations in its discharge resolution for the financial year 1997 (COM(2000) 224 - C5-0223/2000 - 2000/2113(DEC)).
ilsp.proxy: Following the agenda, the report by Mrs van der Laan (A5-0397/2000) on behalf of the Committee on Budgetary Control on the report of the Commission on the measures taken in response to the comments of the European Parliament in its resolution on discharge for the 1997 budget year (COM(2000) 224 - C5-0223/2000 - 2000/2113(DEC)).
ilsp.reference: Following the agenda is the report by Mrs van der Laan (A5-0397/2000) on behalf of the Committee on Budgetary Control on the Commission's report on the measures taken in response to the comments made by the European Parliament in its discharge resolution for the financial year 1997 (COM(2000) 224 - C5-0223/2000 - 2000/2113(DEC)).

ilsp.query: Ich möchte vor allem zwei Punkte hervorheben: Mir ist unverständlich, dass die Kommission immer noch nichts unternommen hat, um eine Kammer für Haushaltsdisziplin beim Rechnungshof oder beim Gerichtshof einzurichten und so eine wirksame Anwendung der Bestimmungen der Haushaltsordnung betreffend die finanzielle Haftbarkeit der Beamten für von ihnen verursachte Schäden zu gewährleisten.
ilsp.judge: I would like to emphasize two points in particular: I find it incomprehensible that the Commission has still not taken any action to establish a chamber for budgetary discipline at the Court of Auditors or the Court of Justice, thus ensuring effective application of the provisions of the Financial Regulation concerning the financial liability of officials for damage caused by them.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to highlight two points in particular: It is incomprehensible to me that the commission has still taken no action to establish a chamber for budget discipline at the Court of Auditors or the Court of Justice, and thus to ensure effective application of the provisions of the budget order regarding the financial liability of officials for damages caused by them.
ilsp.reference: I would like to highlight two points in particular: I find it incomprehensible that the Commission has still not taken any action to establish a chamber for budgetary discipline at the Court of Auditors or the Court of Justice, thereby ensuring effective application of the provisions of the Financial Regulation concerning the financial liability of officials for damage caused by them.

ilsp.query: Es muss jedoch mit Vorsicht gehandhabt werden. Meiner Meinung nach ist es normal, dass das Parlament sich mit den, besonders in den letzten Jahren zahlreich aufgetretenen Mängeln in der Verwaltung der öffentlichen Gelder befasst, die allerdings insbesondere den Mitgliedstaaten anzulasten sind.
ilsp.judge: However, it must be handled with caution. In my opinion, it is normal for Parliament to deal with the shortcomings in the management of public funds, which have been particularly numerous in recent years, but which are particularly attributable to the Member States.
ilsp.proxy: It must, however, be handled with caution. In my opinion, it is normal for the parliament to deal with the, especially in recent years numerous, shortcomings in the administration of public funds, which are, however, particularly attributable to the member states.
ilsp.reference: However, it must be handled with caution. In my opinion, it is normal for the parliament to deal with the numerous shortcomings in the administration of public funds that have occurred, particularly in recent years, which are, however, primarily attributable to the member states.

ilsp.query: Ich denke, dass der Bericht, die Art und Weise des Abschlusses, von dem ich hoffe, dass er endgültig ist und es nicht zu einem neuen Wirbel um das Entlastungsinstrument kommt, uns nun ermöglicht, nach vorn zu blicken und diese Entlastung, die von unserem Parlament lange abgewogen worden ist und die zu Reaktionen von Seiten der Kommission geführt hat, in gewisser Weise als Musterbeispiel zu betrachten.
ilsp.judge: I think that the report, the way in which it was concluded, which I hope is final and that there will not be a new whirlwind around the discharge instrument, now enables us to look forward and to consider this discharge, which has been long weighed by our Parliament and which has led to reactions on the part of the Commission, in a way as a model.
ilsp.proxy: I think that the report, the manner of its conclusion, which I hope is final and does not lead to a new commotion around the relief instrument, now allows us to look forward and in a certain sense consider this relief, which has been weighed for a long time by our parliament and has led to reactions from the Commission, as a model example.
ilsp.reference: I think that the report, the manner of its conclusion, which I hope is final and does not lead to a new controversy surrounding the discharge instrument, now enables us to look to the future and to regard this discharge, which has been carefully weighed by our Parliament and has led to reactions from the Commission, in a certain sense as a model example.

ilsp.judge: (A5-0389/2000) by Mr Staes on behalf of the Committee on Budgetary Control on Special Report No 2/2000 of the Court of Auditors on European Union aid to Bosnia-Herzegovina for the restoration of peace and the rule of law, together with the Commission's replies (C5-0229/2000 - 2000/2131(COS));

ilsp.query: Darüber hinaus hat die Kommission auf Drängen des Rechnungshofs eine Politik der "Dekonzentration " verfolgt, dank deren das Personal in der Vertretung in Sarajewo, aber auch in anderen Vertretungen, effektiver arbeiten und der Leiter der EG-Delegation den Bedürfnissen vor Ort besser Rechnung tragen kann und wodurch es unter anderem ermöglicht wurde, dass der Rückstand bei den Zahlungen heute völlig aufgearbeitet ist.
ilsp.judge: In addition, at the insistence of the Court of Auditors, the Commission has pursued a policy of "deconcentration", thanks to which the staff in the representation in Sarajevo, but also in other representations, can work more effectively and the head of the EC delegation can better meet the needs on the ground, and which, among other things, has made it possible to completely eliminate the backlog in payments today.
ilsp.proxy: In addition, the Commission has pursued a policy of "deconcentration" at the urging of the Court of Auditors, thanks to which the staff in the representation in Sarajevo, but also in other representations, can work more effectively and the head of the EU delegation can better account for the needs on site, thereby, among other things, enabling the arrears in payments to be completely cleared today.
ilsp.reference: Furthermore, the Commission, at the insistence of the Court of Auditors, has pursued a policy of "deconcentration", thanks to which the staff in the representation in Sarajevo, but also in other representations, can work more effectively and the Head of the EC Delegation can better meet the needs on the ground, and which, among other things, has made it possible to completely eliminate the backlog in payments today.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, verehrte Kolleginnen und Kollegen! Die Tatsache, dass die Europäische Union umfangreiche Mittel für den Wiederaufbau und die Förderung der Herstellung der Demokratie in Bosnien-Herzegowina bereitstellt, ist Grund genug für die Aufmerksamkeit, die wir jetzt dem Entschließungsantrag zum Sonderbericht Nr. 2/2000 des Rechnungshofs widmen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, ladies and gentlemen, the fact that the European Union is providing substantial funds for the reconstruction and promotion of democracy in Bosnia-Herzegovina is reason enough for the attention we are now giving to the motion for a resolution on Special Report No 2/2000 of the Court of Auditors.
ilsp.proxy: Honorable President, esteemed colleagues! The fact that the European Union is providing substantial funds for the reconstruction and promotion of democracy in Bosnia and Herzegovina is reason enough for the attention we are now devoting to the resolution motion on the special report No. 2/2000 of the Court of Auditors.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, esteemed colleagues, the fact that the European Union is providing extensive resources for the reconstruction and promotion of democracy in Bosnia and Herzegovina is reason enough for the attention we are now devoting to the resolution on Special Report No 2/2000 by the Court of Auditors.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen ihnen vielmehr zur Seite stehen, wir dürfen ihnen nicht nur mit Worten, mit denen wir lediglich das selbstverständlich allenthalben bestehende Interesse bekunden, sondern müssen ihnen auch mit Taten und natürlich geographisch nahe sein. Vor allem aber müssen wir uns sowohl in die Geschichte als auch in die Psychologie dieser Völker vertiefen.
ilsp.judge: We must stand by them, we must not only speak with words, with which we merely express the self-evident interest everywhere, but we must also act and of course be geographically close. Above all, however, we must delve into both the history and the psychology of these peoples.
ilsp.proxy: We must stand by them rather, we may not just express our interest with words that merely acknowledge the self-evident interest that exists everywhere, but we must also act and be geographically close to them. Above all, however, we must delve into both the history and the psychology of these peoples.
ilsp.reference: We must stand by them, we must not just offer them words that merely express the obvious interest that exists everywhere, but we must also support them with actions and naturally be geographically close. Above all, however, we must delve into both the history and the psychology of these peoples.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident! Trotz der Mittel, die seit Jahren über die Strukturfonds für die Förderung des territorialen Gleichgewichts in der Europäischen Union eingesetzt werden, ist das Pro-Kopf-Einkommen der 25 reichsten Regionen immer noch zweieinhalb Mal höher als das der ärmsten, und trotz der vielen Bedürfnisse dieser strukturschwachen Regionen werden Jahr für Jahr nicht alle Mittel ausgeschöpft, die im Haushalt für die Entwicklung vorgesehen sind.
ilsp.judge: Mr President! Despite the resources that have been deployed for years through the structural funds to promote territorial balance in the European Union, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still two and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the resources provided for in the budget for development are used up year after year.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President! Despite the funds that have been invested in the structural funds for the promotion of territorial balance in the European Union for years, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still two and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the funds allocated in the budget for development are being utilized year after year.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, despite the resources that have been deployed for years through the structural funds to promote territorial balance in the European Union, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still two and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the resources allocated in the budget for development are used year after year.

ilsp.query: Wir können nicht hinnehmen, dass Unternehmen, die in den Genuss von europäischen Beihilfen gekommen sind, wenn sie sich finanziell gesund gestoßen haben, aus Gründen der Strukturanpassung die Entlassung tausender Arbeitnehmer beschließen und damit deren Familien in eine Notlage bringen, zu deren Unterstützung dann wieder nationale und europäische öffentliche Gelder in Anspruch genommen werden.
ilsp.judge: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European aid when they have been financially healthy decide to lay off thousands of workers for reasons of restructuring, thus putting their families in a situation of need, for whose support national and European public funds are then claimed.
ilsp.proxy: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, having financially recovered, decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment and thereby bring their families into a state of emergency, only to then again draw on national and European public funds for their support.
ilsp.reference: We cannot accept that companies which have benefited from European aid when they were financially healthy decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment, thereby putting their families in a precarious situation, for which national and European public funds are then claimed again to provide support.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident! Als Abgeordneter aus jenem Teil Irlands, der sowohl vom IFI als auch vom Fonds für Frieden und Versöhnung profitiert, möchte ich die bisher erzielten Erfolge beider Instrumente hervorheben, und als Abgeordneter, der eng mit lokalen Gruppen und Projekten zusammenarbeitet, die diese Fonds in ausgezeichneter Weise nutzen, möchte ich feststellen, dass ich völlig davon überzeugt bin, dass über alle durch die Fonds ausgereichten Gelder exakt Buch geführt wird.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, as a Member from that part of Ireland which has benefited from both the IFI and the Peace and Reconciliation Fund, I would like to highlight the successes of both instruments to date, and as a Member who works closely with local groups and projects which have used these funds to excellent effect, I would like to state that I am totally convinced that exact account is kept of all monies disbursed through the funds.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President! As a Member of Parliament from that part of Ireland which benefits from both the IFI and the Fund for Peace and Reconciliation, I would like to highlight the achievements of both instruments to date, and as a Member of Parliament who closely works with local groups and projects that make excellent use of these funds, I am completely convinced that every single euro disbursed by the funds is accounted for.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, as a Member from that part of Ireland which has benefited from both the IFI and the Peace and Reconciliation Fund, I would like to highlight the successes achieved to date by both instruments, and as a Member who works closely with local groups and projects which have used these funds to excellent effect, I can state that I am totally convinced that exact accounts are kept of all monies disbursed by the funds.

ilsp.query: Im gesamten Bereich der Milchproduktion haben wir einen Überschuss, und daraus resultieren viele weitere Probleme, insbesondere auch für den Bereich der Finanzkontrolle, weil aus diesem Überschuss spezifische Absatzförderungsmaßnahmen für Magermilchpulver und für Butterfett resultieren, die immer wieder sehr große Probleme bei der Finanzkontrolle aufwerfen oder - mit anderen Worten - Anlass zu Betrug geben.
ilsp.judge: In the entire area of milk production, we have a surplus, and this gives rise to many other problems, especially also for the area of financial control, because from this surplus specific sales promotion measures for skimmed milk powder and for butterfat result, which always cause very big problems in financial control or - in other words - give rise to fraud.
ilsp.proxy: In the entire field of milk production, we have a surplus, and as a result, many further problems arise, particularly also for the area of financial control, because from this surplus specific sales promotion measures for skimmed milk powder and for butterfat result, which always again raise very large problems in financial control or - to put it in other words - provide grounds for fraud.

ilsp.query: Die Definition des beihilfefähigen Magermilchpulvers wurde präzisiert, die Kontrollverfahren wurden insbesondere in Bezug auf den Nachweis von Molke im Magermilchpulver überprüft, und die Beihilfen für flüssige Magermilch zu Futterzwecken wurden aus Kosten-Nutzen-Erwägungen abgeschafft, etwas, wozu es auch eine Menge Kritik gab.
ilsp.judge: The definition of skimmed milk powder eligible for aid was clarified, the control procedures were reviewed, in particular with regard to the proof of whey in skimmed milk powder, and the aid for liquid skimmed milk for feed purposes was abolished for cost-benefit reasons, something that also received a lot of criticism.
ilsp.proxy: The definition of the eligible skimmed milk powder was clarified, the control procedures were reviewed in particular with regard to the proof of buttermilk in skimmed milk powder, and the subsidies for liquid skimmed milk for feeding purposes were abolished due to cost-benefit considerations, something that also sparked a lot of criticism.
ilsp.reference: The definition of skimmed milk powder eligible for aid was clarified, the control procedures were reviewed, particularly with regard to the detection of whey in skimmed milk powder, and the aid for liquid skimmed milk for feed purposes was abolished for cost-benefit considerations, something that also received a lot of criticism.

ilsp.query: Deshalb fordere ich Herrn Bushill-Matthews auf, sich in Zukunft daran zu erinnern - und die Frau Kommissarin Schreyer fordere ich auf, sich jetzt und in Zukunft daran zu erinnern -, dass es zusätzlich zu den in diesem Bericht vorgeschlagenen bedeutsamen Initiativen zweckmäßig wäre, die Mitgliedstaaten zu ersuchen und darauf zu dringen, die neu gegründeten Kleinunternehmen mindestens für die ersten fünf Jahre von der Steuerzahlung zu befreien.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, I call on Mr Bushill-Matthews to remember this in future - and I call on Commissioner Schreyer to remember this now and in future - that, in addition to the significant initiatives proposed in this report, it would be useful to ask and urge the Member States to exempt newly established small businesses from paying tax for at least the first five years.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, I request Mr. Bushill-Matthews to remember this in the future - and I request Commissioner Schreyer to remember this now and in the future - that it would be appropriate, in addition to the significant initiatives proposed in this report, to ask and urge the member states to exempt newly founded small businesses from taxation for at least the first five years.
ilsp.reference: I therefore call on Mr Bushill-Matthews to bear this in mind in the future - and I call on Commissioner Schreyer to bear this in mind now and in the future - that, in addition to the significant initiatives proposed in this report, it would be expedient to request and urge the Member States to exempt newly established small businesses from paying taxes for at least the first five years.

ilsp.query: Die Kommission sollte ein Projektmanagement vorschlagen, "Best Practice "-Methoden entwickeln, Benchmarks einführen, anhand derer überprüft wird, wie viel Zeit vom ersten Antrag bis zur erfolgreichen Schaffung von Arbeitsplätzen vergeht, die Zahlungsströme verfolgen und letztlich das Ganze in der Öffentlichkeit verkaufen.
ilsp.judge: The commission should propose a project management, develop "best practice" methods, introduce benchmarks against which it is checked how much time elapses from the first application to the successful creation of jobs, track the payment streams and ultimately sell the whole thing in the public.
ilsp.proxy: The commission should propose a project management, develop "Best Practice" methods, introduce benchmarks by which it is checked how much time passes from the first application to the successful creation of jobs, track the cash flows and ultimately sell the whole thing to the public.
ilsp.reference: The Commission should propose a project management, develop "best practice" methods, introduce benchmarks to check how much time elapses from the initial application to the successful creation of jobs, track the payment flows, and ultimately sell the whole thing to the public.

ilsp.query: Was die von allen drei Finanzinstrumenten der Initiative Wachstum und Beschäftigung am wenigsten in Anspruch genommene JEV-Fazilität anbetrifft, so sieht das Mehrjahresprogramm für Unternehmen hier eine Vereinfachung der Regelungen vor, damit Anträge von KMU auf finanzielle Unterstützung von den Finanzintermediären und den Diensten der Kommission schneller bearbeitet werden können.
ilsp.judge: As regards the JEREMIE facility, which is the least used of the three financial instruments of the Growth and Employment Initiative, the multi-annual programme for enterprises foresees a simplification of the rules so that SMEs' applications for financial support can be processed more quickly by the financial intermediaries and the Commission services.
ilsp.proxy: As for the JEV-Facility, which is the least used of the three financial instruments of the Growth and Employment Initiative, the multi-year program for companies here foresees a simplification of the regulations so that applications from SMEs for financial support from financial intermediaries and the services of the Commission can be processed faster.
ilsp.reference: As regards the JEREMIE facility, which is the least used of the three financial instruments of the Growth and Employment Initiative, the multi-annual programme for enterprises provides for a simplification of the rules so that applications from SMEs for financial support can be processed more quickly by financial intermediaries and the Commission's services.

ilsp.query: Drittens sollte die Kommission bei sämtlichen bilateralen Steuervereinbarungen, die getroffen werden, sorgfältiger auf die Einhaltung des Grundsatzes des Beschäftigungslandes achten, dem zufolge die Steuergesetzgebung und die soziale Sicherheit zu koordinieren sind, um Problemen vorzubeugen und zu verhindern, dass die Arbeitnehmer zwischen zwei Stühlen sitzen.
ilsp.judge: Thirdly, the Commission should be more careful in ensuring that the principle of the country of employment is respected in all bilateral tax agreements that are concluded, according to which tax legislation and social security are to be coordinated in order to prevent and avoid problems for workers who are caught between two stools.
ilsp.proxy: Thirdly, the Commission should be more careful in all bilateral tax agreements that are made to ensure compliance with the principle of the country of employment, according to which the tax legislation and social security are to be coordinated in order to prevent problems and to prevent workers from being caught between two stools.
ilsp.reference: Thirdly, the Commission should pay closer attention to compliance with the principle of the country of employment in all bilateral tax agreements concluded, whereby tax legislation and social security are to be coordinated in order to prevent problems and prevent workers from falling between two stools.

ilsp.query: Unterdessen bleibt die Welt nicht stehen und werden heute in verschiedenen Ländern Steuerreformen durchgeführt, ist die Gesetzgebung auf dem Gebiet der sozialen Sicherheit voll in Bewegung, werden die gesetzlichen Rentensysteme durch Zusatzrentensysteme ergänzt und werden in zahlreichen Ländern hinsichtlich des Ziels, Berufstätigkeit, Familie und Freizeit zu vereinbaren, diverse Regelungen für eine Unterbrechung der Beschäftigung ausgedacht, die dann nur für die eigenen Staatsangehörigen und leider nicht für die Grenzarbeitnehmer gelten.
ilsp.judge: Meanwhile, the world does not stand still and today tax reforms are being carried out in various countries, legislation in the field of social security is in full swing, statutory pension systems are being supplemented by supplementary pension systems and in numerous countries, with regard to the aim of reconciling employment, family and leisure, various regulations for a break in employment are being devised, which then only apply to their own nationals and unfortunately not to cross-border workers.
ilsp.proxy: Meanwhile, the world does not stand still and tax reforms are being implemented today in various countries, legislation in the field of social security is fully in motion, statutory pension systems are being supplemented by additional pension systems, and in numerous countries, various regulations have been devised regarding the goal of reconciling work, family, and leisure time, which only apply to their own citizens and unfortunately not to border workers.
ilsp.reference: Meanwhile, the world is not standing still, and today, tax reforms are being implemented in various countries, legislation in the field of social security is in full motion, statutory pension systems are being supplemented by additional pension systems, and in numerous countries, various regulations for interrupting employment are being devised to reconcile the goal of work, family, and leisure, which then only apply to their own citizens and unfortunately not to cross-border workers.

ilsp.query: Erstens: In dem Bericht Oomen-Ruijten wird völlig zu Recht die Forderung des Europäischen Parlaments nach Einführung einer Bewertung von Grenzauswirkungen erneuert, wonach die Mitgliedstaaten verpflichtet sind, bei Änderungen ihrer Rechtsvorschriften in den Bereichen soziale Sicherheit und Steuergesetzgebung die Auswirkungen für Grenzarbeitnehmer zu untersuchen, wobei den Grenzarbeitnehmern dadurch entstehende Nachteile ausgeglichen werden sollen, eine Regelung, die von einigen Mitgliedstaaten übrigens nur widerwillig angewandt wird.
ilsp.judge: Firstly, the Oomen-Ruijten report quite rightly renews the European Parliament's call for the introduction of an assessment of cross-border effects, whereby Member States are required to examine the effects for cross-border workers of changes to their legislation in the areas of social security and tax law, with any disadvantages for cross-border workers being offset, a provision which is applied only reluctantly by some Member States, incidentally.
ilsp.proxy: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report entirely rightly reiterates the European Parliament's demand for the introduction of an assessment of border impact effects, according to which member states are obliged to investigate the effects for border workers in the event of changes to their legislation in the areas of social security and tax legislation, where the resulting disadvantages for border workers are to be offset, a regulation that is, incidentally, only reluctantly applied by some member states.
ilsp.reference: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report quite rightly reiterates the European Parliament's call for the introduction of an assessment of cross-border impacts, whereby Member States are required to examine the effects on cross-border workers when amending their legislation in the areas of social security and taxation, with a view to offsetting any disadvantages that may arise for cross-border workers, a provision that is, incidentally, applied only reluctantly by some Member States.

ilsp.query: Um eine qualitativ hochstehende Schulbildung zu sichern, sind genügend Schulen, Klassen mit einer begrenzten Schülerzahl, eine ausreichende Zahl von Lehrkräften, Lehrer und technisches sowie Verwaltungspersonal auf allen Unterrichtsstufen, angefangen von der Grundschule, erforderlich, denn in allen Ländern Europas beginnt gerade in den Grundschulklassen ein Differenzierungsprozess, der sich für die Kinder der weniger begüterten Schichten in einem vielfach nicht wieder auszugleichenden Bildungsrückstand äußert.
ilsp.judge: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, a sufficient number of teachers, teachers and technical and administrative staff at all levels of education, starting from primary school, are required, because in all countries of Europe, a differentiation process is just beginning in the primary school classes, which for the children of the less affluent classes expresses itself in an educational backlog that is often not to be compensated.
ilsp.proxy: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teaching staff, teachers, and technical as well as administrative personnel are required at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in elementary school classes, which manifests itself in a frequently irreparable educational backlog for the children of less affluent strata.
ilsp.reference: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, instructors, and technical as well as administrative staff at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, are required, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins precisely in the elementary school classes, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational disadvantage that cannot be compensated for in many cases.

ilsp.query: Daher müssen wir in diesem Rahmen der Verteidigung, der Wahrung und Förderung unseres Erbes unsere Architektur erhalten, unser Handwerk unterstützen, unsere Landschaften pflegen und erschließen, doch - und das möchte ich hervorheben - ohne sie vom Leben abzuschneiden und ohne die darin lebendigen Traditionen und kulturellen Gebräuche auszuschließen.
ilsp.judge: Therefore, within this framework of defence, preservation and promotion of our heritage, we must preserve our architecture, support our craftsmanship, maintain and develop our landscapes, but - and I would like to emphasise this - without cutting them off from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural customs that exist within them.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, we must preserve our architecture within this framework of defense, preservation, and promotion of our heritage, support our craftsmanship, care for and develop our landscapes, yet - and I would like to emphasize this - without cutting them off from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural practices that reside within them.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, within this framework of defending, preserving, and promoting our heritage, we must preserve our architecture, support our craftsmanship, cultivate and develop our landscapes, but - and I would like to emphasize this - without isolating them from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural customs that thrive within them.

ilsp.query: Das Europäische Parlament muss sein tiefstes Bedauern über die antisemitischen Inhalte in Lehrmitteln für palästinensische Schulen zum Ausdruck bringen und die Kommission auffordern, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Beihilfen für den Erziehungs- und Bildungsbereich in Palästina weder direkt noch indirekt den Rassenhass finanzieren, sondern Frieden und Versöhnung im Nahen Osten fördern.
ilsp.judge: The European Parliament must express its deepest regret over the anti-Semitic content in textbooks for Palestinian schools and call on the Commission to ensure that aid for the education and training sector in Palestine neither directly nor indirectly finances racial hatred, but promotes peace and reconciliation in the Middle East.
ilsp.proxy: The European Parliament must express its deepest regret over the anti-Semitic contents in educational materials for Palestinian schools and call on the Commission to ensure that aid for the education and training sector in Palestine does not directly or indirectly finance racism, but rather promotes peace and reconciliation in the Middle East.
ilsp.reference: The European Parliament must express its deepest regret over the antisemitic content in teaching materials for Palestinian schools and call on the Commission to ensure that aid for the education sector in Palestine neither directly nor indirectly finances racial hatred, but rather promotes peace and reconciliation in the Middle East.

ilsp.judge: As regards my explanation of vote on the Staes report on the Committee on Budgetary Control and specifically the EU aid to Bosnia-Herzegovina or the use of the funds for this purpose, I would like to mention that I had a meeting with the representatives of the pensioners of this region.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht des Parlaments offenbart vor allem, wie die genannten Finanzmittel verwaltet wurden, und zeigt die unkontrollierte, undurchsichtige Verschwendung von Steuergeldern der EU-Bürger auf, die ungeachtet der erklärten "humanitären und friedenstiftenden " Absichten zur Absicherung des Vordringens der großen Interessen der EU im NATO-Protektorat Bosnien eingesetzt werden.
ilsp.judge: The report of the Parliament reveals above all how the funds mentioned were managed, and shows the uncontrolled, opaque waste of taxpayers' money of EU citizens, which is used regardless of the declared "humanitarian and peacekeeping" intentions to secure the advance of the great interests of the EU in the NATO protectorate Bosnia.
ilsp.proxy: The parliamentary report reveals above all how the mentioned financial means were managed, and shows the uncontrolled and opaque waste of EU citizens' tax money, which is used despite the declared "humanitarian and peace-promoting" intentions to secure the advancement of the EU's major interests in the NATO protectorate of Bosnia.
ilsp.reference: The parliamentary report reveals, above all, how the aforementioned funds were managed, and exposes the uncontrolled, opaque squandering of EU citizens' tax money, which, despite the declared "humanitarian and peacekeeping" intentions, is being used to secure the advancement of the EU's major interests in the NATO protectorate of Bosnia.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für den Bericht Dell'Alba gestimmt, doch möchte ich betonen, dass sich hinter dieser Zustimmung mein Standpunkt als Vertreter der italienischen Rentnerpartei verbirgt, den ich hiermit darlegen möchte: Ich bin unter allen Umständen gegen die inzwischen übliche und zur Gewohnheit gewordene Forderung, die Strukturfonds und die Gemeinschaftshilfen zu den einzelstaatlichen Hilfen hinzuzurechnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, I voted in favour of the Dell'Alba report, but I would like to stress that behind this vote lies my position as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party, which I would like to explain here: I am in any case against the now usual and customary demand to add the structural funds and Community aid to the national aid.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, I did vote for the Dell'Alba report, but I would like to emphasize that my stance as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party is hidden behind this vote, which I would like to present here: I am opposed to the demand, which has become a habit and is now customary, to include the structural funds and community aid in the individual state aid.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, although I voted in favour of the Dell'Alba report, I would like to stress that behind this approval lies my position as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party, which I would like to outline as follows: I am, under all circumstances, opposed to the now common and habitual demand to add the Structural Funds and Community assistance to national assistance.

ilsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
ilsp.judge: Let us just consider - and I am referring to my country - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the delivery of milk to the supermarket, is really controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to keep a comprehensive environmental and customer account for a long time - which they do with great commitment - and how at the same time the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.
ilsp.proxy: Let's bring this to mind for a moment - and I'm referring to my country here - how in the dairy industry everything, from the grass blade to milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been leading a comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they do with great enthusiasm, by the way - and how, at the same time, animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.
ilsp.reference: Let's just take a moment to consider - and I'm referring to my country here - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to maintain comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they also do with great dedication -, and how at the same time, the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

ilsp.query: Auffälligerweise wird bei der gesamten Wettbewerbspolitik der Europäischen Union dem Wettbewerb zwar große Beachtung geschenkt, nehmen jedoch beispielsweise im Futtermittelsektor die Abnehmer, die Supermärkte, allmählich eine Monopolstellung ein, während gleichzeitig der Vertrieb durch die Bauernhöfe, durch den kleinen landwirtschaftlichen Betrieb, noch zersplittert ist.
ilsp.judge: Remarkably, in the entire competition policy of the European Union, competition is given great attention, but for example in the feed sector, the buyers, the supermarkets, are gradually taking a monopoly position, while at the same time the distribution through the farms, through the small agricultural enterprise, is still fragmented.
ilsp.proxy: Notably, while great attention is paid to competition policy in the European Union as a whole, for example in the feed sector, the buyers, such as supermarkets, are gradually taking on a monopolistic position, while at the same time the distribution through farms, through the small agricultural operation, is still fragmented.
ilsp.reference: Notably, while the European Union's competition policy pays great attention to competition, for example, in the feed sector, the buyers, the supermarkets, are gradually taking on a monopolistic position, whereas the distribution through farms, through small agricultural businesses, is still fragmented.

ilsp.query: Wir erfahren, "dass die Europäische Zentralbank erklärt hat, sie werde es nicht zulassen, dass die Europäische Betrugsbekämpfungsbehörde OLAF interne Untersuchungen durchführt ", dass "der Überwachungsausschuss des OLAF in seinem ersten Bericht an das Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission forderte, Klagen gegen die Organe der Kommission zu erheben, die die Verordnung 1073/99 nicht bis Ende 1999 umgesetzt hätten " und "dass die Kommission am 12. Januar 2000 vor dem Europäischen Gerichtshof Klage gegen den Beschluss der Europäischen Zentralbank vom 7. Oktober 1999 im Hinblick auf die Nichtanwendung der Verordnung Nr. 1073/99 des Parlaments und des Rates erhob ".

ilsp.query: Dies alles sehen wir als sehr schwerwiegend an und unterstützen die Passage des Berichts, in welcher der "eindeutige Widerspruch zwischen der von der EZB in ihrem Jahresbericht für 1999 öffentlich eingegangenen Verpflichtung, eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem OLAF aufzubauen, und dem Beschluss der EZB, OLAF daran zu hindern, interne Untersuchungen durchzuführen, wobei das Urteil des Europäischen Gerichtshofs noch aussteht, " bedauert wird.
ilsp.judge: We consider all this to be very serious and support the passage of the report in which the "clear contradiction between the commitment publicly undertaken by the ECB in its 1999 annual report to establish close cooperation with OLAF and the ECB's decision to prevent OLAF from carrying out internal investigations, pending the judgment of the Court of Justice of the European Communities, " is regretted.

ilsp.query: Ich hatte beantragt, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen finanziell zu unterstützen, wenn sie die Gewohnheit annehmen, bei ihrer Gründung einem enthusiastischen und arbeitswilligen Jungunternehmer einen älteren Unternehmer, einen Senior, zur Seite zu stellen, der alles weiß, der sich auskennt, der ihm sein Wissen vermitteln kann, auch wenn er keine große Lust mehr hat, lange zu arbeiten, und der dankbar wäre, wenn er seinen Erfahrungsschatz an die jungen Leute weitergeben könnte.
ilsp.judge: I had applied for financial support for small and medium-sized enterprises if they adopt the habit of placing an enthusiastic and hard-working young entrepreneur next to an older entrepreneur, a senior, who knows everything, who is familiar with it, who can impart his knowledge to him, even if he no longer has a great desire to work long and who would be grateful if he could pass on his wealth of experience to the young people.
ilsp.proxy: I had requested to financially support small and medium-sized enterprises if they adopt the habit of assigning an older entrepreneur, a senior, to a young and enthusiastic entrepreneur at the time of their founding, who knows everything, is well-informed, can pass on his knowledge to him, even if he no longer has a strong desire to work long hours, and who would be grateful if he could pass on his treasure trove of experience to the young people.
ilsp.reference: I had proposed financially supporting small and medium-sized enterprises if they adopt the habit of assigning an enthusiastic and hardworking young entrepreneur an older entrepreneur, a senior, by their side at the time of their founding, someone who knows everything, who is familiar with the business, who can impart their knowledge, even if they no longer have a great desire to work long hours, and who would be grateful if they could pass on their wealth of experience to the young people.

ilsp.query: Einrichtungen, die mit Grenzarbeitnehmern zu tun haben, sind für den Grundsatz des Wohnlandes, die Gewerkschaften plädieren für den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes, die Regierung selbst wiederum spricht sich für das Wohnlandprinzip aus usw. usw. Da der Knoten jedoch endlich einmal durchgeschlagen werden muss, werden wir einige der von Frau Oomen-Ruijten eingereichten Änderungsanträge, denen zufolge beide Grundsätze gemischt angewendet werden sollten, nicht unterstützen und schlagen vor, den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes als Ausgangspunkt zu nehmen und auf das so genannte europäische Sozialmodell hinzuarbeiten.
ilsp.judge: Facilities dealing with cross-border workers are for the principle of the country of residence, the trade unions are for the principle of the country of employment, the government itself again speaks for the principle of the country of residence, etc. etc. However, since the knot must finally be cut, we will not support some of the amendments submitted by Mrs Oomen-Ruijten, according to which both principles should be applied in a mixed way, and propose to take the principle of the country of employment as a starting point and to work towards the so-called European social model.
ilsp.proxy: Institutions dealing with frontier workers are for the principle of the country of residence, trade unions advocate for the principle of the country of employment, the government itself again speaks out in favor of the country of residence principle, etc. etc. However, the knot must finally be broken through, we will not support some of the amendments submitted by Mrs. Oomen-Ruijten, according to which both principles should be applied in a mixed manner, and instead propose to take the principle of the country of employment as a starting point and work towards the so-called European social model.

ilsp.query: Zudem dürften die Meinungen darüber, wie sinnvoll die im Bericht enthaltenen Empfehlungen zur Besteuerung im Beschäftigungsstaat sind, auseinandergehen, zumal generell von den Steuerverwaltungen der Standpunkt vertreten wird, dass bei der Beurteilung der steuerlichen Gesamtsituation des Steuerzahlers vorrangig der Wohnsitzstaat und weniger der Beschäftigungsstaat in Betracht gezogen werden sollte.
ilsp.judge: In addition, opinions on how sensible the recommendations on taxation in the country of employment contained in the report are likely to differ, especially since the tax authorities generally take the view that the residence state should be considered first and foremost when assessing the taxpayer's overall tax situation, rather than the country of employment.
ilsp.proxy: In addition, opinions may differ on how sensible the tax recommendations contained in the report are for the state of employment, as tax administrations generally take the position that, when assessing the taxpayer's overall tax situation, the residence state should be given priority over the state of employment.
