ilsp.query: Dazu zählen die Umwelthaftung, durch die die Mitgliedstaaten stärker in die Pflicht genommen werden, die bestehenden Vorschriften und Regelungen einzuhalten. Es gehören Beschwerde- und Untersuchungsverfahren auf nationaler Ebene dazu, bei denen wir beratend tätig werden, weiterhin der Zugang zu den Gerichten, juristische Ausbildungsmaßnahmen, die ebenfalls sehr wichtig sind, denn es geht hier auch um Bildungsbelange, sowie die Veröffentlichung dieser Jahresübersicht über die Umsetzung der Rechtsvorschriften zum Umweltschutz.
ilsp.judge: These include environmental liability, which makes Member States more accountable for complying with existing regulations and regulations. It includes complaint and investigation procedures at national level, where we act in an advisory capacity, as well as access to the courts, legal training, which is also very important, because it is also about educational issues, as well as the publication of this annual review of the implementation of environmental protection legislation.
ilsp.proxy: This also includes environmental liability, through which the member states are taken more seriously into account to comply with existing regulations and provisions. It involves complaint and investigation procedures at the national level, in which we will be advisory, continued access to the courts, legal training measures, which are also very important, because it is also about educational matters, as well as the publication of this annual overview of the implementation of environmental protection regulations.
ilsp.reference: These include environmental liability, which holds Member States more accountable for complying with existing regulations and rules. They also include complaint and investigation procedures at the national level, where we provide advisory services, as well as access to courts, legal training measures, which are also very important, as educational concerns are also at stake here, and the publication of this annual overview of the implementation of environmental protection legislation.

ilsp.query: Es hat wenig genutzt, dass wir im Namen des Schutzes der Volksgesundheit das Verbot von PCB und die Dekontamination aller PCB und PCT enthaltenden Geräte beschlossen haben, wenn nach fünf Jahren die überwiegende Mehrheit der Mitgliedstaaten die Richtlinie nicht nur nicht umsetzt, sondern nicht einmal das getan hat, was am einfachsten wäre: die PCB-Bestandsaufnahme und Pläne zur Dekontamination.
ilsp.judge: It has been of little use that we have decided to ban PCB and the decontamination of all PCB and PCT containing devices in the name of protecting public health, if after five years the overwhelming majority of Member States have not only failed to implement the directive, but have not even done what would have been easiest: the PCB inventory and plans for decontamination.
ilsp.proxy: It has made little difference that we decided on the ban of PCB and the decontamination of all devices containing PCB and PCT in the name of protecting public health, if after five years the overwhelming majority of member states have not only not implemented the directive, but have not even done what would be the easiest thing: conducting a PCB inventory and drawing up plans for decontamination.
ilsp.reference: It has been of little use that we have decided, in the name of protecting public health, to ban PCB and decontaminate all devices containing PCB and PCT, if after five years the vast majority of Member States have not only failed to implement the directive, but have not even done what would have been easiest: taking stock of PCB and drawing up decontamination plans.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte zwei Aspekte dieser Entwicklung hervorheben: Zum einen wird in unseren Ländern der Umweltschutz nur zögerlich in die Konzepte der verschiedenen sektoralen Politiken aufgenommen und stattdessen nach wie vor als eine Reihe von im Nachhinein durchzuführenden Maßnahmen betrachtet, mit denen eventuelle Schäden behoben werden können; zum anderen werden gerade aufgrund dieses nachträglichen Handelns die Kosten der Umsetzung der Richtlinien häufig als zu belastend und nicht wirklich sinnvoll empfunden, was auch auf die knappen von den Mitgliedstaaten bereitgestellten Mittel zurückzuführen ist.
ilsp.judge: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: on the one hand, environmental protection is only hesitantly incorporated into the concepts of the various sectoral policies in our countries and is still considered as a series of measures to be carried out afterwards, with which possible damage can be remedied; on the other hand, precisely because of this subsequent action, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as too burdensome and not really meaningful, which is also due to the scarce funds provided by the Member States.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: On the one hand, environmental protection is only gradually being incorporated into the concepts of various sectoral policies in our countries and is instead still viewed as a series of measures to be taken after the fact to rectify any damage; on the other hand, the costs of implementing the guidelines are often felt to be too burdensome and not truly meaningful, which can also be attributed to the limited funds provided by the member states.
ilsp.reference: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: Firstly, environmental protection is only being gradually incorporated into the concepts of various sectoral policies in our countries, and is instead still viewed as a series of measures to be implemented retrospectively to rectify any potential damage; secondly, precisely due to this retrospective approach, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as too burdensome and not really meaningful, which can also be attributed to the limited funds provided by the Member States.

ilsp.query: Auch ich schließe mich der Auffassung an, dass das Fünfte Umweltaktionsprogramm hauptsächlich auf einen sektoralen Ansatz der Umweltpolitik abzielte, und vielleicht sollten wir, wenn wir uns Gedanken über das Sechste Programm machen, mehr Nachdruck auf die Einbeziehung der sozioökonomischen Akteure sowie der lokalen Behörden bei der Erreichung der jeweils festgelegten Ziele legen, damit der Schutz unserer Umwelt immer mehr in die Gesamtplanung integriert wird.
ilsp.judge: I also agree with the view that the Fifth Environmental Action Programme was mainly aimed at a sectoral approach to environmental policy, and perhaps when we think about the Sixth Programme, we should put more emphasis on the inclusion of socio-economic actors as well as local authorities in achieving the objectives set, so that the protection of our environment is increasingly integrated into overall planning.
ilsp.proxy: I also subscribe to the view that the Fifth Environmental Action Programme primarily aimed at a sectoral approach to environmental policy, and perhaps when we think about the Sixth Programme, we should put more emphasis on the inclusion of socio-economic actors as well as local authorities in achieving the respective set targets, so that the protection of our environment is increasingly integrated into overall planning.
ilsp.reference: I also share the view that the Fifth Environmental Action Programme mainly focused on a sectoral approach to environmental policy, and perhaps when we think about the Sixth Programme, we should place more emphasis on involving socio-economic actors and local authorities in achieving the set objectives, so that the protection of our environment is increasingly integrated into overall planning.

ilsp.query: Eindeutige Anweisungen sind zwar nützlich und notwendig, doch erstaunt es mich, dass so viele Kolleginnen und Kollegen eine Überarbeitung der Vogel- und Habitatrichtlinie fordern, um bestimmte darin enthaltene Begriffe, wie "wesentliche Folgen ", "Ausgleichsregelung " und "überwiegend öffentliches Interesse ", noch exakter zu definieren.
ilsp.judge: Clear instructions are useful and necessary, but I am surprised that so many colleagues are calling for a revision of the Birds and Habitats Directives in order to define certain terms contained therein, such as "significant effects", "compensation scheme" and "overriding public interest", even more precisely.
ilsp.proxy: Clear instructions are indeed useful and necessary, but it surprises me that so many colleagues are calling for a revision of the bird and habitat guidelines to more precisely define certain terms contained within, such as "substantial consequences", "compensatory regulation", and "overriding public interest".
ilsp.reference: Clear instructions are indeed useful and necessary, yet I am surprised that so many colleagues are calling for a revision of the Birds and Habitats Directive to define certain terms contained therein, such as "significant impact", "compensatory measures" and "overriding public interest", even more precisely.

ilsp.query: Einmal im Hinblick auf den Umweltschutz, den Hauptzweck der Richtlinien. Aber es ist auch sehr wichtig, dass das Vertrauen in die Gesetzgebung der EU nicht erschüttert wird, indem die Mitgliedstaaten die Gesetze lange Zeit nicht umsetzen, an deren Beschluss im Ministerrat sie selbst beteiligt waren.
ilsp.judge: Once with a view to environmental protection, the main purpose of the directives. But it is also very important that confidence in EU legislation is not undermined by Member States failing to implement the laws for a long time, in whose decision in the Council of Ministers they themselves were involved.
ilsp.proxy: Once in the context of environmental protection, the main purpose of the guidelines. But it is also very important that the trust in EU legislation is not shaken by the member states not implementing laws for a long time, in whose adoption they themselves participated in the Council of Ministers.
ilsp.reference: On the one hand, with regard to environmental protection, the main purpose of the guidelines. But it is also very important that trust in EU legislation is not shaken by Member States failing to implement the laws for a long time, on whose adoption in the Council of Ministers they themselves were involved.

ilsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich Neil Parish und der Kommission empfehlen, diesen Bericht nicht als einen Schlusspunkt, sondern als Ausgangspunkt für ein gründliches Nachdenken über die Erneuerung der Landwirtschaft und die Reform der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik unter Einbeziehung vor allem der Vereinigungen der Junglandwirte zu sehen.
ilsp.judge: In conclusion, I would like to recommend to Neil Parish and the Committee that they do not see this report as a full stop, but as a starting point for a thorough reflection on the renewal of agriculture and the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, especially with the involvement of the young farmers' associations.
ilsp.proxy: In conclusion, I would like to recommend to Neil Parish and the Commission to view this report not as a final point, but as a starting point for thorough reflection on the renewal of agriculture and the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, taking into account especially the associations of young farmers.
ilsp.reference: In conclusion, I would like to recommend to Neil Parish and the Commission that they view this report not as a full stop, but as a starting point for thorough reflection on the renewal of agriculture and the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, particularly involving the associations of young farmers.

ilsp.query: Diese zukünftige soziale Gemeinschaft bildet die Grundlage der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik, für die wir die Niederlassungsbeihilfe und die zusätzlichen Investitionshilfen verstärken müssen, hauptsächlich in jenen strukturschwachen Regionen mit zahlreichen stillgelegten Betrieben und verlassenen Dörfern, wo die jungen Leute die ländliche Wirtschaft wieder ankurbeln können, und zwar durch die Entwicklung von neuartigen Produkten wie dem Agrotourismus, dem ländlichen Tourismus von regionaler Bedeutung oder durch die Wiederansiedlung von Tier- und Pflanzenarten in diesen Naturräumen, womit ein Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen und dauerhaften Entwicklung der Region geleistet wird.
ilsp.judge: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and the additional investment aid, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous closed-down businesses and abandoned villages, where young people can reinvigorate the rural economy, and that by developing new products such as agrotourism, rural tourism of regional importance or by the resettlement of animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby contributing to a sustainable and lasting development of the region.
ilsp.proxy: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and additional investment incentives, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous abandoned businesses and deserted villages, where young people can revitalize the rural economy by developing new products such as agrotourism, regional rural tourism of importance, or by re-colonizing animal and plant species in these natural environments, thereby contributing to a sustainable and lasting development of the region.
ilsp.reference: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and additional investment aid, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous abandoned businesses and deserted villages, where young people can revive the rural economy, and this through the development of innovative products such as agrotourism, rural tourism of regional importance, or through the reintroduction of animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby making a contribution to a sustainable and lasting development of the region.

ilsp.query: Zweitens fehlt es in den meisten Fällen an Möglichkeiten, die Anreize auch wirklich zu nutzen. So kann sich ein Junglandwirt aufgrund der Quoten nicht wirklich betätigen, da die Quoten für alle Erzeugnisse ausgeschöpft sind und er entweder warten muss, bis eine nationale Reserve gebildet und auf die Junglandwirte aufgeteilt wird, oder aber Quoten aufkaufen muss, was ihn aber nie auf einen grünen Zweig bringen dürfte.
ilsp.judge: Secondly, in most cases there are no opportunities to actually use the incentives. Thus, a young farmer cannot really engage in farming due to the quotas being exhausted for all products, and he must either wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to young farmers, or purchase quotas, which should never bring him any green shoots.
ilsp.proxy: Secondly, in most cases, there is a lack of opportunities to actually utilize the incentives. So, a young farmer cannot really operate due to the quotas, as the quotas for all products are exhausted, and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to young farmers, or he has to buy quotas, which would never bring him to a green branch.
ilsp.reference: Secondly, in most cases, there is a lack of opportunities to actually take advantage of the incentives. Thus, a young farmer cannot really get started due to the quotas, as the quotas for all products are exhausted and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to the young farmers, or he has to buy quotas, which should never bring him a profit.

ilsp.query: In diesem Sinne sind dringend einige grundlegende Maßnahmen in der Richtung geboten, wie sie ja auch vom Berichterstatter vorgeschlagen wird, und zwar vor allem durch die Schaffung von speziellen Reserven an Produktionsquoten und -rechten ausschließlich für die Junglandwirte, durch die Erhöhung der Beihilfen für die Erstniederlassung und für Investitionen in die landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe, durch ein spezielles Kreditanreizsystem in Ergänzung zu den anderen Investitionsbeihilfen, durch die Schaffung von Bedingungen für ernstgemeinte Vorruhestandregelungen für ältere Landwirte, die den Erneuerungsprozess beschleunigen, sowie durch Maßnahmen in den Bereichen Ausbildung und Information.
ilsp.judge: In this sense, some basic measures are urgently needed in the direction proposed by the rapporteur, in particular by creating special reserves of production quotas and rights exclusively for young farmers, by increasing aid for the first installation and for investments in agricultural holdings, by a special credit incentive system in addition to other investment aid, by creating conditions for serious early retirement schemes for older farmers to accelerate the renewal process, and by measures in the fields of training and information.
ilsp.proxy: In this sense, some fundamental measures are urgently required in this direction, as proposed by the rapporteur, and primarily through the creation of special reserves for production quotas and rights exclusively for young farmers, through the increase of subsidies for first-time settlers and for investments in agricultural businesses, through a special credit incentive system in addition to other investment subsidies, through the creation of conditions for genuine early retirement regulations for older farmers that accelerate the renewal process, as well as through measures in the areas of education and information.
ilsp.reference: In this sense, some fundamental measures are urgently needed in the direction proposed by the rapporteur, namely the creation of special reserves of production quotas and rights exclusively for young farmers, the increase in aid for initial installation and investment in agricultural holdings, a special credit incentive system to supplement other investment aid, the creation of conditions for genuine early retirement schemes for older farmers to accelerate the renewal process, and measures in the areas of training and information.

ilsp.query: Nicht zufällig führen wir, nach der Verabschiedung der Agenda 2000, in der gegenwärtigen neuen Verhandlungsphase der WTO sowie nunmehr am Vorabend der nächsten Erweiterung, auch heute hier wieder eine Diskussion über die Zukunft der Junglandwirte, jener jungen Leute, die in vielen Ländern unserer Union auf die Möglichkeit einer dauerhaften Tätigkeit im Agrarsektor setzen.
ilsp.judge: It is no coincidence that, following the adoption of Agenda 2000, in the current new phase of WTO negotiations and now on the eve of the next enlargement, we are again discussing here today the future of young farmers, those young people who in many countries of our Union are counting on the possibility of a permanent activity in the agricultural sector.
ilsp.proxy: Not coincidentally, we are, following the adoption of Agenda 2000, in the current new phase of WTO negotiations as well as on the eve of the next enlargement, having this discussion again today here about the future of young farmers, those young people who in many countries of our Union are pinning their hopes on the possibility of a permanent occupation in the agricultural sector.
ilsp.reference: It is no coincidence that, following the adoption of Agenda 2000, in the current new phase of WTO negotiations and now on the eve of the next enlargement, we are once again holding a discussion here today about the future of young farmers, those young people who in many countries of our Union are counting on the possibility of a long-term career in the agricultural sector.

ilsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
ilsp.judge: Let us just consider - and I am referring to my country - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the delivery of milk to the supermarket, is really controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to keep a comprehensive environmental and customer account for a long time - which they do with great commitment - and how at the same time the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.
ilsp.proxy: Let's bring this to mind for a moment - and I'm referring to my country here - how in the dairy industry everything, from the grass blade to milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been leading a comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they do with great enthusiasm, by the way - and how, at the same time, animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.
ilsp.reference: Let's just take a moment to consider - and I'm referring to my country here - how everything in the dairy industry, from the blade of grass to the milk delivery in the supermarket, is actually controlled, how farmers and gardeners have been required to maintain comprehensive environmental and customer accounting for a long time - which they also do with great dedication -, and how at the same time, the animal welfare regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

ilsp.query: Auffälligerweise wird bei der gesamten Wettbewerbspolitik der Europäischen Union dem Wettbewerb zwar große Beachtung geschenkt, nehmen jedoch beispielsweise im Futtermittelsektor die Abnehmer, die Supermärkte, allmählich eine Monopolstellung ein, während gleichzeitig der Vertrieb durch die Bauernhöfe, durch den kleinen landwirtschaftlichen Betrieb, noch zersplittert ist.
ilsp.judge: Remarkably, in the entire competition policy of the European Union, competition is given great attention, but for example in the feed sector, the buyers, the supermarkets, are gradually taking a monopoly position, while at the same time the distribution through the farms, through the small agricultural enterprise, is still fragmented.
ilsp.proxy: Notably, while great attention is paid to competition policy in the European Union as a whole, for example in the feed sector, the buyers, such as supermarkets, are gradually taking on a monopolistic position, while at the same time the distribution through farms, through the small agricultural operation, is still fragmented.
ilsp.reference: Notably, while the European Union's competition policy pays great attention to competition, for example, in the feed sector, the buyers, the supermarkets, are gradually taking on a monopolistic position, whereas the distribution through farms, through small agricultural businesses, is still fragmented.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte Ihnen sagen, dass im letzten Jahrzehnt des zu Ende gegangenen Jahrhunderts sowohl die Konferenz von Wien wie auch in der Folge die Konferenz von Peking neue Horizonte eröffneten, damit wir die ganz konkrete Situation berücksichtigen, unter der die Frauen in einer Vielzahl von Ländern leiden. Doch ich glaube, der Kommissar versteht das von Frau Izquierdo dargestellte Problem, und ich wäre dankbar, wenn Vorschläge in dieser Richtung gemacht würden.
ilsp.judge: I would like to tell you that in the last decade of the century that has just ended, both the Vienna Conference and, subsequently, the Beijing Conference opened up new horizons so that we can take into account the very concrete situation under which women suffer in a variety of countries. But I believe that the Commissioner understands the problem presented by Mrs Izquierdo, and I would be grateful if proposals were made in this direction.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to tell you that in the last decade of the past century, both the Vienna Conference and subsequently the Beijing Conference opened up new horizons, so that we can take into account the very concrete situation under which women suffer in a multitude of countries. However, I believe the Commissioner understands the problem presented by Mrs. Izquierdo, and I would be grateful if proposals in this direction were made.

ilsp.query: Ist der Kommission bewusst, dass sie durch die Rücknahme des Anspruchs auf Exporterstattungen für aus landwirtschaftlichen Rohstoffen erzeugte chemische Produkte die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der europäischen chemischen Industrie zusätzlich schwer beeinträchtigt hat, die ohnehin auf Größenordnungsvorteile, die die Glukose-Lieferanten der US-Industrie nutzen können, wegen des EU-Quotensystems für Isoglukose und des Fehlens eines Äthanolprogramms in der EU verzichten muss?
ilsp.judge: Is the Commission aware that by withdrawing the claim for export refunds for chemical products produced from agricultural raw materials, it has further seriously impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry, which is already unable to take advantage of economies of scale that US industry glucose suppliers can use because of the EU quota system for isoglucose and the lack of an ethanol program in the EU?
ilsp.proxy: Is the Commission aware that by withdrawing the claim for export refunds on chemically produced products made from agricultural raw materials, it has further severely impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry, which already has to forgo scale advantages that glucose suppliers to the US industry can utilize due to the EU's isoglucose quota system and the absence of an ethanol program in the EU?
ilsp.reference: Is the Commission aware that by withdrawing the entitlement to export refunds for chemical products produced from agricultural raw materials, it has further severely impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry, which in any case has to forgo the economies of scale that US industry glucose suppliers can exploit, due to the EU quota system for isoglucose and the absence of an ethanol programme in the EU?

ilsp.query: Da dies ein für die solidarische Entwicklung der spanischen Regionen so bedeutungsvolles Projekt ist, zweifle ich nicht an den wiederholten Äußerungen, Zusagen oder Bestätigungen des Umweltministers, dass dies ein offenes Dokument ist, dass es sich um einen Entwurf, um einen Vorschlag handelt, zu dem zweifellos ein Konsens zwischen allen betroffenen Regionen gefunden werden muss. Meine Frage, Frau Kommissarin, ist folgende: Welche Unterstützung kann gerade die Kommission im Rahmen der äußerst engen Zusammenarbeit zwischen ihr und der spanischen Regierung und innerhalb der in der Rahmenrichtlinie vorgesehenen Situationen geben, damit dieses Projekt ordnungsgemäß weitergeführt wird?
ilsp.judge: As this is a project of such importance for the solidary development of the Spanish regions, I have no doubt about the repeated statements, promises or confirmations of the Minister for the Environment that this is an open document, that it is a draft, a proposal, to which, without doubt, a consensus must be reached between all the regions concerned. My question, Commissioner, is the following: what support can the Commission itself give, within the very close cooperation between it and the Spanish Government and within the situations provided for in the framework directive, to ensure that this project is properly continued?
ilsp.proxy: Given that this is such a significant project for the solidary development of the Spanish regions, I have no doubt about the repeated statements, promises, or confirmations made by the Environment Minister that this is an open document, that it is a draft, a proposal, for which there is undoubtedly a consensus that must be found among all the affected regions. My question, Commissioner, is as follows: What support can the Commission provide, specifically in the framework of the extremely close cooperation between it and the Spanish government, and within the situations foreseen in the framework directive, so that this project can be properly continued?
ilsp.reference: As this is a project of such significance for the solidarity-based development of the Spanish regions, I do not doubt the repeated statements, commitments or confirmations made by the Minister for the Environment that this is an open document, that it is a draft, a proposal on which a consensus must undoubtedly be found among all the regions concerned. My question, Commissioner, is as follows: what support can the Commission provide, within the very close cooperation between it and the Spanish Government and in the situations provided for in the framework directive, to ensure that this project is properly pursued?

ilsp.query: Dabei weiß die Kommission, dass die britische Aufsichtsbehörde seit der Veröffentlichung des Revisionsberichts im November ihre Zufriedenheit geäußert hat, wie British Nuclear Fuels Limited beispielsweise mit den fünfzehn spezifischen Empfehlungen des Berichts für die Vorführanlage verfahren ist, und dass diese Empfehlungen, wie es in der Nuklearterminologie heißt, abgeschlossen wurden, das heißt, als erfüllt betrachtet werden.
ilsp.judge: In this regard, the Commission is aware that the UK supervisory authority has expressed its satisfaction, since the publication of the review report in November, with the way in which British Nuclear Fuels Limited has dealt with the fifteen specific recommendations of the report for the demonstration facility, and that these recommendations, as it is called in nuclear terminology, have been closed, that is to say, considered to be fulfilled.
ilsp.proxy: The Commission is aware that the UK regulatory body has expressed its satisfaction since the publication of the review report in November, for example, as British Nuclear Fuels Limited has handled the fifteen specific recommendations of the report for the demonstration facility, and that these recommendations, as it is called in nuclear terminology, have been completed, that is, considered fulfilled.
ilsp.reference: In this context, the Commission is aware that the British supervisory authority has expressed its satisfaction, since the publication of the revision report in November, with the way British Nuclear Fuels Limited has dealt with the fifteen specific recommendations of the report for the demonstration facility, and that these recommendations, as the nuclear terminology puts it, have been completed, i.e. are considered fulfilled.

ilsp.query: Frau Ahern, meine Damen und Herren! Die Kommission schätzt die erzielten Fortschritte und teilt den Wunsch der Inspektoren, einen anhaltenden Impuls für die Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur auf allen Führungsebenen zu sehen, und natürlich werden wir im Rahmen unserer Zuständigkeiten, oder auf diesem Gebiet eher der uns ermangelnden Zuständigkeiten, die Ereignisse in Sellafield weiter im Auge behalten.
ilsp.judge: Mrs Ahern, ladies and gentlemen! The Commission welcomes the progress made and shares the inspectors' wish to see a sustained impetus for improving the safety culture at all levels of management, and of course we will continue to monitor events at Sellafield within our remit, or rather the remit that we lack in this area.
ilsp.proxy: Mrs. Ahern, ladies and gentlemen! The Commission appreciates the progress achieved and shares the inspectors' desire to see a sustained impulse for the improvement of the safety culture at all levels of leadership, and of course, we will continue to monitor the events in Sellafield within our areas of responsibility, or rather, within the areas where we lack responsibility.
ilsp.reference: Mrs Ahern, ladies and gentlemen! The Commission welcomes the progress made and shares the inspectors' desire to see a sustained drive to improve the safety culture at all levels of management, and of course, within the limits of our competence, or rather the lack thereof in this area, we will continue to keep a close eye on developments in Sellafield.

ilsp.query: Auf jeden Fall möchte ich natürlich unserem Wunsch Ausdruck geben, dass British Nuclear Fuels schnellstmöglich alle Empfehlungen, nicht nur drei, sondern die 28, in ihrem weiteren Vorgehen und ihrer Tätigkeit in Sellafield erfüllt, und sollten diese Empfehlungen nicht alle verwirklicht werden können, das haben die britischen Behörden schon gesagt, müssten sie natürlich Entscheidungen in dieser Angelegenheit treffen.
ilsp.judge: In any case, I would of course like to express our wish that British Nuclear Fuels should as soon as possible fulfil all the recommendations, not just three, but the 28, in their further approach and their activities in Sellafield, and should these recommendations not all be able to be implemented, as the British authorities have already said, they would of course have to take decisions in this matter.
ilsp.proxy: In any case, I would like to express our wish that British Nuclear Fuels implements all recommendations, not just three, but the 28, as quickly as possible in their further actions and activities at Sellafield, and if these recommendations cannot all be implemented, as the British authorities have already said, they would of course have to make decisions on this matter.
ilsp.reference: In any case, I would naturally like to express our desire that British Nuclear Fuels fulfills all 28 recommendations, not just three, as quickly as possible in their further proceedings and activities in Sellafield, and if these recommendations cannot all be implemented, as the British authorities have already said, they would of course have to make decisions in this matter.

ilsp.query: Angesprochen wird auch eine stärkere Nutzung von Verkehrsträgern wie beispielsweise der Binnen- oder Kurzstrecken-Seeschifffahrt, und vor allem geht es um die Förderung der Integration des Verkehrssystems, denn letztlich wird früher oder später in der Regel immer der Straßenverkehr genannt, wenn es um die Absicherung des Transports "von Haus zu Haus " geht, was ein entscheidendes Element ist.
ilsp.judge: It also addresses the increased use of modes of transport such as inland or short sea shipping, and above all it is about promoting the integration of the transport system, because sooner or later the road transport is always mentioned when it comes to securing the transport "from door to door", which is a decisive element.
ilsp.proxy: Discussed is also a stronger utilization of transportation modes such as, for example, inland or short-distance sea shipping, and above all, it is about promoting the integration of the transportation system, because ultimately, the road traffic is usually mentioned in the end, when it comes to securing the transport "from house to house", which is a crucial element.
ilsp.reference: There is also a call for greater use of modes of transport such as inland or short-sea shipping, and above all, it is about promoting the integration of the transport system, because ultimately, sooner or later, road transport is usually mentioned when it comes to securing transport "from door to door", which is a crucial element.

ilsp.query: Abschließend und im Rahmen dieser Hilfen für die erneuerbaren Energien, die für mich wesentlich sind und nicht nur für Erklärungen herhalten, sondern eine Zielsetzung darstellen - und denken Sie daran, dass zum ersten Mal Staat für Staat konkrete und differenzierte Ziele aufgestellt werden und zwar in der Richtlinie über grüne Energie -, halte ich es auf jeden Fall für unerlässlich, der Forschung im Nuklearsektor weiterhin Unterstützung zu geben, insbesondere im Bereich der Sicherheit, Lagerung und Aufbereitung von Rückständen, denn sie u vergraben ist keine Lösung, oder bei Alternativfragen wie beispielsweise der Kernfusion.
ilsp.judge: Finally, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are essential for me and not only for declarations, but also a goal - and remember that for the first time state by state concrete and differentiated goals are set and that is in the directive on green energy - I consider it absolutely essential to continue to support research in the nuclear sector, especially in the field of safety, storage and processing of residues, because it is not a solution to bury it, or in alternative questions such as nuclear fusion.
ilsp.proxy: In conclusion, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are essential to me and not just there to provide explanations, but represent a goal-setting - and remember that for the first time, state by state, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I firmly believe it is essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying it is no solution, or in alternative questions such as, for example, nuclear fusion.
ilsp.reference: In conclusion, and within the framework of these measures to support renewable energy, which are essential to me and not just for explanations, but represent a goal - and remember that for the first time, country by country, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I consider it essential to continue providing support to research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying them is not a solution, or in alternative questions such as nuclear fusion.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, da wir dieses Thema gestern in unserem Fischereiausschuss behandelt haben, möchte ich Sie im Namen des Ausschusses sowie und vor allem im Namen der Berichterstatter, die wir heute über das Thema debattieren werden, darum bitten, sofern der Herr Kommissar, mit dem ich gesprochen habe, keine Einwände hat - und die hat er im Prinzip nicht -, dass wir zunächst die Erklärung des Kommissars selbst hören und wir, die übrigen Berichterstatter, entsprechend der festgelegten Reihenfolge im Anschluss daran zu Wort kommen können.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, as we discussed this subject in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the Committee and, above all, on behalf of the rapporteurs who will be debating the subject today, if the Commissioner, with whom I have spoken, has no objection - and he does not in principle - that we first hear the Commissioner's statement and that the other rapporteurs then speak in the order established.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, since we have already discussed this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the committee and above all on behalf of the rapporteurs who we will be debating on this topic today, to please, if the Commissioner with whom I have spoken has no objections - and he doesn't, in principle - that we first hear the Commissioner's explanation and that the rest of the rapporteurs can then speak in the established order afterwards.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, since we dealt with this topic in our Fisheries Committee yesterday, I would like to ask you, on behalf of the Committee and, above all, on behalf of the rapporteurs who will be debating the topic today, provided that the Commissioner, with whom I have spoken, has no objections - and in principle, he does not - that we first hear the Commissioner's statement and that the rest of us rapporteurs can then speak in the established order.

ilsp.query: Mit dem Ziel, die Öffentlichkeit auf dieses entscheidende Datum so umfassend wie möglich vorzubereiten - was meiner Meinung nach eine gute Idee war -, hat die Kommission einen Prozess der Konsultation aller an dieser Aktivität beteiligten bzw. von ihr betroffenen Partner durchgeführt, indem sie eine Fragebogenaktion startete und Zusammenkünfte durchführte, von denen insgesamt 30 mit nahezu 1500 Teilnehmern stattfanden.
ilsp.judge: With the aim of preparing the public as comprehensively as possible for this crucial date - which I think was a good idea - the Commission has carried out a process of consultation of all partners involved in or affected by this activity, by launching a questionnaire campaign and holding meetings, of which a total of 30 were held with nearly 1,500 participants.
ilsp.proxy: With the aim of preparing the public as comprehensively as possible for this crucial date - which, in my opinion, was a good idea - the commission conducted a process of consultation with all partners involved in or affected by this activity by launching a questionnaire campaign and holding meetings, a total of 30 of which took place with nearly 1500 participants.
ilsp.reference: With the aim of preparing the public for this crucial date as comprehensively as possible - which I think was a good idea - the Commission conducted a consultation process involving all partners involved in or affected by this activity, by launching a questionnaire campaign and holding meetings, a total of 30 of which took place with nearly 1,500 participants.

ilsp.query: Da der von der Kommission vorgelegte Vorschlag im Wesentlichen derselbe ist, dem wir im März 1999 zugestimmt haben, und da der veranschlagte Finanzbetrag, der derselbe wie im geltenden Protokoll ist, wie der Vorschlag für konkrete Zwecke bestimmt ist, halte ich es als Berichterstatter für angebracht, dass das Parlament diesem Vorschlag zustimmt.
ilsp.judge: As the proposal submitted by the Commission is essentially the same as the one we agreed to in March 1999, and as the budgetary amount, which is the same as in the current protocol, is intended for specific purposes, I consider it appropriate as rapporteur that the Parliament agrees to this proposal.
ilsp.proxy: Since the proposal put forward by the Commission is essentially the same as the one we agreed to in March 1999, and since the estimated financial amount, which is the same as in the current protocol, is determined for specific purposes, I consider it as rapporteur appropriate that the Parliament approves this proposal.

ilsp.query: Ihre Anwesenheit geht auf ein Ersuchen der PSE-Fraktion in der Konferenz der Präsidenten zurück, und ich erinnere Sie daran, dass Sie im Oktober 1999, einen Monat vor dem Auslaufen des Abkommens, hier sagten, dass Sie sich "massiv dafür einsetzen würden, dass es hier zu einer Lösung kommt " und dass Sie "auch nasse Füße in Kauf nehmen würden ".
ilsp.judge: Their presence is in response to a request from the PSE Group in the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that you said here in October 1999, one month before the agreement expired, that you would "make a massive effort to get a solution here" and that you would "also get wet feet".
ilsp.proxy: Your presence is a result of a request from the PSE faction in the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that in October 1999, a month before the agreement expired, you said here that you would "massively work towards a solution" and that you would "even take wet feet" in the process.
ilsp.reference: Your presence is a response to a request from the PSE Group in the Conference of Presidents, and I remind you that in October 1999, one month before the agreement expired, you said here that you would "strongly advocate for a solution to be found here" and that you would "also take the risk of getting wet feet".

ilsp.query: Das Problem besteht für mich darin, dass es keine Abstimmung zwischen den Bemühungen der verschiedenen Dienste der Kommission gegeben hat, dass kein ausreichender politischer Impuls des Rates vorhanden war und es seitens der Regierung des am stärksten betroffenen Landes keine deutlichen Worte, kein kluges Vorgehen und keine parallele Arbeit gegeben hat, was meiner Meinung nach der gravierendste Punkt ist.
ilsp.judge: The problem for me is that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various Commission services, that there has been no sufficient political impetus from the Council and that there has been no clear words, no wise approach and no parallel work on the part of the government of the country most affected, which in my opinion is the most serious point.
ilsp.proxy: The problem lies in the fact that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various services of the commission, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the council, and that from the government of the most affected country, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most critical point.
ilsp.reference: The problem for me is that there was no coordination between the efforts of the Commission's various services, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the Council, and that on the part of the government of the country most affected, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most serious point.

ilsp.query: Wir verbringen hier ganze Tage mit der Diskussion über das demokratische Defizit und die verantwortungsvolle Regierung der Union und wenn wir dann eine Angelegenheit behandeln, die direkte Auswirkungen auf über 4 000 Fischer hat, wollen wir nicht sehen, was offenkundig ist, und nicht tun, was jede Regierung tun würde, um einen so bedeutenden Teil ihres produktiven Geflechts zu schützen.
ilsp.judge: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the responsible government of the Union and when we then deal with a matter that has direct effects on over 4 000 fishermen, we do not want to see what is obvious and not do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of its productive fabric.
ilsp.proxy: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the Union's responsible government, and when we then deal with a matter that has direct impacts on over 4,000 fishermen, we don't want to see what's obvious and we won't do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of their productive network.
ilsp.reference: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the responsible government of the Union, and when we then deal with a matter that has a direct impact on over 4,000 fishermen, we do not want to see what is obvious and do not do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of its productive fabric.

ilsp.query: Deshalb wiederhole ich, dass uns die Kommission nicht ernsthaft einen Entwurf des Grünbuchs, wie den von ihr erarbeiteten, vorschlagen kann, betrachtet man die offenkundige Unzufriedenheit mit der Ressourcenpolitik, deren brillante Ergebnisse wir gerade auf dem Rat vom Dezember gesehen haben, die Unwilligkeit über ein TAC-System, das die Rückwürfe fördert, die Tatsache, dass solche Themen wie die relative Stabilität und die Freiheit des Zugangs zu lösen sind, gar nicht zu reden davon, dass die einzige Gemeinschaftspolitik, in der immer noch Diskriminierungen aufgrund der Staatszugehörigkeit existieren, an die Verträge angepasst werden muss.
ilsp.judge: That is why I repeat that the Commission cannot seriously propose to us a draft of the Green Paper, such as the one it has drawn up, if one considers the obvious dissatisfaction with the resource policy, whose brilliant results we have just seen at the December Council, the unwillingness over a TAC system which encourages discards, the fact that such issues as relative stability and freedom of access have to be resolved, not to mention the fact that the only Community policy in which discrimination on grounds of nationality still exists has to be brought into line with the Treaties.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, I repeat that the Commission cannot seriously propose a draft of the Green Book, such as the one it has prepared, when considering the obvious discontent with the resource policy, whose brilliant results we have just seen at the Council in December, the unwillingness to accept a TAC system that promotes returns, the fact that issues such as relative stability and freedom of access need to be resolved, not to mention the fact that the only community policy in which discriminations based on nationality still exist needs to be adapted to the treaties.
ilsp.reference: That is why I repeat that the Commission cannot seriously suggest to us a draft Green Paper, such as the one it has drawn up, given the obvious dissatisfaction with the policy on resources, whose brilliant results we have just seen in the December Council, the unwillingness to have a TAC system that encourages discards, the fact that such issues as relative stability and freedom of access have yet to be resolved, not to mention the fact that the only Community policy in which discrimination on grounds of nationality still exists must be adapted to the Treaties.

ilsp.query: Wenn die Kommission wirklich glaubt, dass die Zukunft der europäischen Fischerei nicht einmal mehr über die einfache Änderung einer Verordnung, sondern über den Vorschlag von Maßnahmen führt, die bereits in den derzeitigen Verordnungen enthalten sind, wenn der große Vorschlag und die große Entdeckung der Kommission für die künftige GFP in den Mehrjahres-TACs und in der Förderung der Aquakultur bestehen, dann ist vielleicht der Zeitpunkt gekommen, Herr Präsident, mit aller Ernsthaftigkeit zu fordern, dass man anderen Personen Platz macht, die neue Ideen und ein Minimum an Verantwortungsgefühl einbringen können.
ilsp.judge: If the Commission really believes that the future of European fisheries does not even lie in the simple amendment of a regulation, but in the proposal of measures which are already contained in the current regulations, if the great proposal and the great discovery of the Commission for the future GFP lie in the multiannual TACs and in the promotion of aquaculture, then perhaps the time has come, Mr President, to call with all seriousness for others to make way for people who can bring new ideas and a minimum of responsibility.
ilsp.proxy: If the Commission truly believes that the future of European fisheries does not even depend on a simple amendment to a regulation, but rather on the proposal of measures that are already contained in the current regulations, if the Commission's major proposal and major discovery for future GFP in multi-year TACs and in the promotion of aquaculture are valid, then perhaps the time has come, Mr. President, to demand with all seriousness that others be given space, who can bring new ideas and a minimum of responsibility.
ilsp.reference: If the Commission truly believes that the future of European fisheries is no longer about simply amending a regulation, but about proposing measures that are already contained in the current regulations, if the Commission's great proposal and great discovery for future GFP lie in the multi-annual TACs and in promoting aquaculture, then perhaps the time has come, Mr. President, to seriously demand that others make way for people who can bring new ideas and a minimum sense of responsibility.

ilsp.query: Einerseits ist jeder Einzelne der hier Anwesenden am Fortbestand der Fischereiindustrie interessiert, und zwar nicht zuletzt deshalb, weil wir gern dessen Produkt essen; andererseits gibt es ernst zu nehmende wissenschaftliche Hinweise auf eine Verknappung der Fischbestände, die im Falle einiger Arten deren Verschwinden zur Folge haben kann.
ilsp.judge: On the one hand, each and every one of us present here is interested in the continuation of the fishing industry, not least because we like to eat its product; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a shortage of fish stocks, which in the case of some species can lead to their disappearance.
ilsp.proxy: On the one hand, each individual present here is interested in the continuation of the fishing industry, and this is not least because we like to eat its products; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a shortage of fish stocks, which in the case of certain species can lead to their disappearance.
ilsp.reference: On the one hand, every individual present here is interested in the continued existence of the fishing industry, not least because we like to eat its products; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a depletion of fish stocks, which in the case of some species can lead to their disappearance.

ilsp.query: Die Gemeinschaftsbeihilfen müssen hauptsächlich für einen echten Kapazitätsabbau sowie für Investitionen in den Umweltschutz und die Qualitätsförderung bestimmt sein, wobei es um folgende Maßnahmen geht: eine Fangtageregelung in sämtlichen EU-Mitgliedstaaten, mit der wir in meinem Land hervorragende Erfahrungen gesammelt haben, was sich auch bei dem vor einigen Monaten in Brüssel stattgefundenen Treffen zur Gemeinsamen Fischereipolitik gezeigt hat.
ilsp.judge: Community aid must be mainly intended for a real reduction in capacity as well as for investments in environmental protection and quality promotion, including the following measures: a day's catch regulation in all EU Member States, with which we have had excellent experiences in my country, which was also shown at the meeting on the Common Fisheries Policy held in Brussels a few months ago.
ilsp.proxy: Community aids must primarily be determined for a genuine capacity reduction as well as for investments in environmental protection and quality promotion, with the following measures in mind: a catch limit regulation in all EU member states, with which we have collected excellent experiences in my country, which has also been shown at the recent meeting in Brussels on the Common Fisheries Policy.
ilsp.reference: Community assistance must be mainly intended for genuine capacity reduction and for investments in environmental protection and quality promotion, involving the following measures: a system of days at sea in all EU Member States, with which we have had excellent experience in my country, as was also shown at the meeting on the Common Fisheries Policy held in Brussels a few months ago.

ilsp.query: Auch unterstreichen die beiden Berichterstatter folgende gravierenden Mängel, die bereits im Kommissionsbericht festgestellt wurden: die Beschränkungen des Fischereiaufwands haben nicht oder nur ungenügend funktioniert, die Verordnung über technische Maßnahmen im Mittelmeer ist nur lückenhaft umgesetzt worden, das MAP 4 ist bei weitem nicht ehrgeizig genug, die Kontrollbestimmungen wurden nicht, wie von uns 1998 vorgeschlagen, verstärkt.
ilsp.judge: The two rapporteurs also underline the following serious shortcomings, which were already identified in the Commission's report: the restrictions on fishing effort have not worked or have been insufficient, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has only been implemented in a piecemeal manner, the MAP 4 is by far not ambitious enough, the control provisions have not been strengthened, as we proposed in 1998.
ilsp.proxy: Both rapporteurs also emphasize the following serious shortcomings that were already identified in the commission report: the restrictions on fishing effort have not or only insufficiently worked, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has been only patchily implemented, MAP 4 is by far not ambitious enough, and the control provisions were not strengthened, as we had proposed in 1998.
ilsp.reference: The two rapporteurs also highlight the following serious shortcomings, which were already identified in the Commission report: the restrictions on fishing effort have not worked or have been insufficient, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has been implemented only patchily, MAP 4 is by no means ambitious enough, and the control provisions have not been strengthened as we proposed in 1998.

ilsp.query: Die von den drei Berichterstattern übereinstimmend genannten Hauptziele dieses Reformprozesses sind ausweislich der Entschließungsanträge folgende: die Überkapazitäten abbauen und die Kohärenz mit umweltpolitischen Maßnahmen verbessern, um die Bestände zu erhalten und wiederherzustellen, die direkt Betroffenen stärker in die Entscheidungen einbinden und lokale oder dringende Probleme effizienter lösen, um die Einhaltung und die Durchsetzung der Regelungen zu sichern und das Fischereimanagement insgesamt zu verbessern, also alles, was unter das Stichwort good governance fällt.
ilsp.judge: The main objectives of this reform process, as stated in the resolution proposals, are as follows: to reduce overcapacity and improve coherence with environmental measures in order to maintain and restore stocks, to involve those directly affected more in the decisions and to solve local or urgent problems more efficiently, to ensure compliance and enforcement of the regulations and to improve fisheries management in general, i.e. everything that falls under the heading of good governance.
ilsp.proxy: The main objectives of this reform process, as unanimously stated by the three rapporteurs, are as follows, according to the draft resolutions: to reduce overcapacity and improve coherence with environmental policy measures in order to maintain and restore the stocks, to more strongly involve the directly affected parties in the decision-making process and to solve local or urgent problems more efficiently in order to ensure compliance with and enforcement of the regulations and to improve fisheries management overall, thus covering everything under the heading of good governance.
ilsp.reference: The main objectives of this reform process, consistently cited by the three rapporteurs, as evident from the resolution proposals, are as follows: to reduce overcapacity and improve coherence with environmental policy measures in order to maintain and restore stocks, to involve those directly affected more closely in decision-making and to resolve local or urgent problems more efficiently, to ensure compliance with and enforcement of the regulations and to improve fisheries management overall, i.e. everything that falls under the heading of good governance.

ilsp.query: Auf unserer Reise durch dieses noch junge Land fanden wir all dies bestätigt: die wachsende Armut und die Schwierigkeiten im Gesundheits- und Bildungswesen, aber auch einige sich abzeichnende Chancen, die Initiativen im Ergebnis der Zusammenarbeit, die in den verschiedensten Bereichen sowohl in staatlicher Verantwortung oder von den NRO durchgeführt werden, die gewinnbringende Nutzung - wenn auch in begrenztem Umfang - von Kleinstkrediten, die Rolle und die besonders schwierige Lage der Frauen.
ilsp.judge: On our journey through this still young country we found all this confirmed: the growing poverty and the difficulties in the health and education sectors, but also some emerging opportunities, the initiatives as a result of cooperation, which are carried out in the most diverse areas both in state responsibility or by the NGOs, the profitable use - albeit to a limited extent - of microcredits, the role and the particularly difficult situation of women.
ilsp.proxy: On our journey through this still young country, we found all of this confirmed: the growing poverty and the difficulties in the healthcare and education systems, but also some emerging opportunities, the initiatives as a result of cooperation, which are carried out in various fields both in state responsibility and by NGOs, the profitable use - albeit to a limited extent - of microcredits, the role and the particularly difficult situation of women.
ilsp.reference: On our journey through this still young country, we found all of this confirmed: the growing poverty and the difficulties in the healthcare and education systems, but also some emerging opportunities, the initiatives resulting from cooperation, which are being carried out in various areas, both under state responsibility and by NGOs, the profitable use - albeit to a limited extent - of microcredits, the role and the particularly difficult situation of women.

ilsp.query: Das heißt andererseits aber auch, dass es noch schlimmer wird, wenn wir gerade ein solches Land im Stich lassen, weil Bangladesch viele Probleme nicht hat, die wir in anderen Ländern vorfinden, und wir lassen das Land im Stich, wenn wir keine erhebliche Entwicklungshilfe und sonstige Unterstützung leisten.
ilsp.judge: On the other hand, however, this also means that it will get even worse if we abandon such a country, because Bangladesh has many problems that we do not find in other countries, and we abandon the country if we do not provide significant development aid and other support.
ilsp.proxy: This means, on the other hand, that it will get even worse if we just abandon a country like this, because Bangladesh does not have many of the problems we find in other countries, and we abandon the country if we do not provide significant development aid and other support.
ilsp.reference: That also means, on the other hand, that things will get even worse if we abandon a country like this, because Bangladesh does not have many of the problems that we find in other countries, and we are abandoning the country if we do not provide significant development aid and other support.

ilsp.query: Ich kann nicht vergessen, wie ich im Jahre 1994, als ich mein Land als Außenminister vertrat, aufmerksam die Ergebnisse und Schlussfolgerungen dieses Parlaments las, in denen die Außenminister der Staaten der Union zum Handeln aufgerufen wurden und gefordert wurde, dieser Missachtung der Menschenrechte durch die Gewalt in Bosnien-Herzegowina Einhalt zu gebieten.
ilsp.judge: I cannot forget how, in 1994, when I represented my country as Foreign Minister, I read with great attention the results and conclusions of this Parliament, which called on the Foreign Ministers of the States of the Union to act and demanded that this disregard for human rights by the violence in Bosnia-Herzegovina be stopped.

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin, verehrte Kolleginnen und Kollegen! 1950, ich war damals 20 Jahre alt, wurde in der ganzen Welt, auch in Europa, an unseren Universitäten, an den Schulen - sie versuchten sogar, in die Kirchen einzudringen, was ihnen allerdings nicht gelang - eine Kampagne ausgelöst, und zwar die Kampagne gegen Ridgway, den so genannten "Pest-General ".
ilsp.judge: Madam President, dear colleagues! In 1950, when I was 20 years old, a campaign was launched all over the world, also in Europe, at our universities, at schools - they even tried to penetrate the churches, which, however, did not succeed - and that was the campaign against Ridgway, the so-called "pest general".

ilsp.query: Wir haben in der Vergangenheit immer wieder gesagt: Wenn es notwendig ist, Waffen einzusetzen, - da waren wir uns immer einig - muss dies mit dem geringst möglichen Eingriff, mit dem geringst möglichen Schaden für die Umwelt und für die Gesundheit der Menschen, die dann überlebt haben, verbunden sein.
ilsp.judge: We have said in the past: If it is necessary to use weapons, - we have always agreed on that - this must be done with the least possible intervention, with the least possible damage to the environment and to the health of the people who have survived.

ilsp.judge: We are not talking about the last proof, and when we talked about our own health and about BSE in this house, we were all in agreement that the precautionary principle applies, even though we could never provide direct proof that infected material leads to the new variant of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir behandeln heute ein äußerst wichtiges Thema, auf das eigentlich sehr viel Zeit verwendet und zu dem sehr eingehende Überlegungen angestellt werden müssten, während wir es allerdings voller Emotionen angehen, die der Politik, zu der wir doch hier als Nichtfachleute gehalten sind, schlecht zu Gesicht stehen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, we are dealing with a very important subject today, which should actually be given a great deal of time and very careful consideration, but which we are in fact approaching with a great deal of emotion, which does not look good for the politics to which we are supposed to be non-experts here.

ilsp.query: Erstens, Herrn Solana möchte ich sagen, dass, als wir 1999 zusammen mit anderen Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Erfahrung bringen wollten, ob im Kosovo abgereichertes Uran benutzt wird, sträfliches Schweigen herrschte, und Frau Wallström hat in ihrer Antwort auf eine Anfrage - ich habe hier das Protokoll vorliegen - wörtlich gesagt, noch sei nicht bestätigt, ob nicht angereichertes Uran eingesetzt worden sei.
ilsp.judge: First, Mr Solana, I would like to say that, when we were trying to find out in 1999, together with other colleagues, whether depleted uranium was being used in Kosovo, there was a guilty silence, and Mrs Wallström, in her reply to a question - I have the minutes here - said literally that it had not yet been confirmed that non-enriched uranium had been used.

ilsp.query: Nordkorea hat Mühe, die wenigen und ohnehin symbolhaften Verpflichtungen, die es auf militärischem Gebiet übernommen hat, einzuhalten; es verzögert die Zusammenführung der seit dem Krieg in den 50er Jahren getrennten Familien und lässt durch nichts seinen Willen erkennen, den Gegenbesuch von Kim Jong Il in Seoul, der für das kommende Frühjahr vorgesehen war und von dem noch nicht bekannt ist, wann und ob er stattfinden wird, auch wirklich in die Tat umzusetzen.
ilsp.judge: North Korea is having trouble keeping the few and already symbolic commitments it has made on the military front; it is delaying the reunification of families separated by the war in the 50s and is not showing any willingness to actually carry out the reciprocal visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was scheduled for next spring and which is still unknown when and whether it will take place.

ilsp.query: (FR) Der Bericht von Jonas Sjöstedt von der GUE/NGL-Fraktion über den Schutz der natürlichen Lebensräume in Europa ist unseres Erachtens von großer Bedeutung, insbesondere für Frankreich. Dieses Land zählt nämlich zu denjenigen Staaten, in denen die Durchführung der über acht Jahre alten Habitat-Richtlinie und der über 20 Jahre alten Vogelschutzrichtlinie - sowie die Schaffung des Netzes Natura 2000 - am stärksten vernachlässigt wurde, so dass ihre tatsächliche Umsetzung bereits fraglich geworden ist.
ilsp.judge: (FR) The report by Jonas Sjöstedt of the GUE/NGL Group on the protection of natural habitats in Europe is, in our view, of great importance, especially for France. This country is indeed one of those states in which the implementation of the Habitat Directive, which is now more than eight years old, and the Bird Protection Directive, which is now more than 20 years old, as well as the creation of the Natura 2000 network, have been most neglected, so that their actual implementation has already become questionable.

ilsp.query: Die Kommission als Hüterin der Verträge muss sich einerseits unnachgiebig gegenüber den Mitgliedstaaten zeigen, damit diese die Richtlinien einhalten, und andererseits muss sie sich den Bestrebungen zur Änderung dieser Texte widersetzen, bevor sie ihre volle Nützlichkeit unter Beweis stellen konnten, insbesondere in den Bereichen der Verunreinigung der Gewässer durch Nitrate sowie des Schutzes und der Aufwertung besonders wertvoller Naturräume.
ilsp.judge: The Commission, as guardian of the Treaties, must on the one hand be inflexible towards the Member States so that they comply with the directives, and on the other hand it must resist the attempts to amend these texts before they have been able to prove their full usefulness, particularly in the areas of pollution of waters by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural areas.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What is happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our Member States certainly does not help to motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully states, they have an important social function to fulfil by devoting themselves to the care and maintenance of the landscape and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
ilsp.judge: We must, also in the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the designations of origin of our quality products, including wine, because our future in the EU and what the export to third countries is concerned, lies in high-quality products, for which there are solvent and mature consumers here, and also in the world.
ilsp.proxy: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.
ilsp.reference: We must also defend and secure the designations of origin of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are solvent and discerning consumers both here and around the world.

ilsp.query: Da die Gemeinschaft gemäß der einschlägigen Erklärung in Artikel 5 Absatz 1 des Anhangs IX des Internationalen Seerechtsübereinkommens allein für die Erhaltung und Bewirtschaftung der Fischbestände zuständig und damit befugt ist, die entsprechenden Regeln und Bestimmungen festzulegen, sollte die Kommission von dieser Befugnis Gebrauch machen und das ausschließliche Fangrecht auch für die griechischen Fischer auf 12 Seemeilen festlegen.
ilsp.judge: Since the Community, in accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and is therefore empowered to lay down the corresponding rules and provisions, the Commission should make use of this power and establish the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.
ilsp.proxy: In accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5, paragraph 1 of Annex IX to the International Convention on the Law of the Sea, the community is responsible and authorized for the conservation and management of fish stocks, and thus entitled to establish the corresponding rules and regulations. ilsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
ilsp.judge: The joint resolution on the "Balkan syndrome" is only intended to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of defending human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.

(FR) The fact that the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of ammunition with depleted uranium, even for those who use it, only proves that the general staffs have the same contempt for their own soldiers as for the civilian population and the opposing forces.
