ilsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
ilsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions to be taken when handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element when inhaled or ingested, which is also genetically dangerous.
ilsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.
ilsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.

ilsp.query: Angesichts des Ausmaßes des Verbrechens gegen ganze Zivilbevölkerungen ist es dringend notwendig, die Hauptverantwortlichen für diese verbrecherischen Akte gegen die Menschlichkeit zu ermitteln, ihre Schuld festzustellen und sie zu verurteilen sowie die Herstellung, Erprobung, Benutzung und den Verkauf von Waffen mit abgereichertem Uran unverzüglich zu verbieten und nicht nur ein Moratorium anzunehmen.
ilsp.judge: Given the magnitude of the crime against entire civilian populations, it is urgent to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, to determine their guilt and to condemn them, as well as to prohibit the manufacture, testing, use and sale of weapons with depleted uranium immediately and not only to adopt a moratorium.
ilsp.proxy: In light of the scale of the crimes committed against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these heinous acts against humanity, to establish their guilt, and to condemn them, as well as to immediately prohibit the production, testing, use, and sale of uranium-enriched weapons and to adopt not only a moratorium.
ilsp.reference: In view of the extent of the crime against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, to establish their guilt and to condemn them, as well as to immediately prohibit the production, testing, use and sale of weapons with depleted uranium and not just adopt a moratorium.

ilsp.query: Wir alle wissen, dass diese Waffen, die von der NATO im Golfkrieg (1991), in Bosnien (1994-95) und im Kosovo (1999) eingesetzt wurden, schwerwiegende Folgen zunächst für die bombardierte Zivilbevölkerung, aber auch für die Umwelt und die Militärangehörigen der NATO, der irakischen, bosnischen, serbischen und kosovarischen Streitkräfte hatten.
ilsp.judge: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had serious consequences first for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian and Kosovar armed forces.
ilsp.proxy: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had severe consequences initially for the civilian population that was bombed, but also for the environment and the NATO military personnel, as well as the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian, and Kosovo military forces.
ilsp.reference: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95), and in Kosovo (1999), had severe consequences initially for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian, and Kosovar forces.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, after all the tragic events connected with the bombing of Yugoslavia and after the revelations about the use of ammunition with depleted uranium, it is now urgent to ban this type of weapon, which even after its use still has dangerous effects over a long period of time and blind, i.e. without recognizable difference, can affect all those who are at risk of coming into contact with them.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, in light of the tragic events surrounding the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which, even after its use, has hazardous effects for a long time and can, blind, i.e., without discernible distinction, affect all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, following all the tragic events connected with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of ammunition with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which even after use still has dangerous effects over a long period and strikes blindly, i.e. without distinction, all those who risk coming into contact with them.

ilsp.query: Ebenso wichtig und dringlich ist es, eine umfassende Politik der Hilfe, der Prävention und der Sanierung für all die Gebiete in Jugoslawien zu konzipieren, die unter den Folgen des Einsatzes dieser Geschosse zu leiden haben, um so die Volksgesundheit und die Umwelt schützen, Böden und Gewässer sanieren und eine stetige wirtschaftliche Entwicklung des Landes und der gesamten Region gewährleisten zu können.
ilsp.judge: Equally important and urgent is the need to conceive a comprehensive policy of assistance, prevention and rehabilitation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering the consequences of the use of these shells, in order to protect public health and the environment, rehabilitate soils and water, and ensure the steady economic development of the country and the entire region.
ilsp.proxy: It is equally important and urgent to design a comprehensive policy of aid, prevention, and rehabilitation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these munitions, in order to protect public health and the environment, to restore soils and waters, and to ensure a steady economic development of the country and the entire region.
ilsp.reference: It is equally important and urgent to conceive a comprehensive policy of assistance, prevention, and rehabilitation for all areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these munitions, in order to protect public health and the environment, rehabilitate soils and waters, and ensure the steady economic development of the country and the entire region.

ilsp.query: (EN) Herr Präsident, meine Damen und Herren. Im Namen meines Kollegen, Herrn Patten, der bereits nach Moskau abgereist ist, möchte ich dem Parlament zur heutigen Aussprache gratulieren, weil sie uns eine wertvolle Gelegenheit zum Meinungsaustausch über die bevorstehende Sitzung der UN-Menschenrechtskommission in Genf bietet.
ilsp.judge: (Mr President, ladies and gentlemen. On behalf of my colleague, Mr Patten, who has already left for Moscow, I would like to congratulate the Parliament on today's debate, as it gives us a valuable opportunity to exchange views on the forthcoming session of the UN Commission on Human Rights in Geneva.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen. ilsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
ilsp.judge: I have also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American and Russian spies.
ilsp.proxy: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
ilsp.reference: I also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a former KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

ilsp.query: Ich befürchte, dass auch dieses Jahr meine Partei, die Radikale Partei, leider wieder zu den wenigen gehören wird, die mit Wei Jinsheng und einigen anderen die Menschenrechte in China und in Tibet verteidigen, die die Tschetschenienfrage mit Nachdruck ansprechen werden, während der Rat und die von ihm vertretene Union in der UNO wieder einmal nicht in Erscheinung treten werden.
ilsp.judge: I fear that this year, too, my party, the Radical Party, will unfortunately be among the few to defend human rights in China and Tibet with Wei Jinsheng and some others, to address the Chechnya issue forcefully, while the Council and the Union it represents in the UN will once again not be present.
ilsp.proxy: I fear that this year as well, my party, the Radical Party, unfortunately will again be among the few who, along with Wei Jinsheng and a few others, will defend human rights in China and in Tibet, who will address the Chechen issue with emphasis, while the Council and the Union it represents will once again not make an appearance in the UN.

ilsp.query: Selbstverständlich, Herr Präsident, stimme ich der Kritik an China wegen Tibet, an Russland wegen Tschetschenien, der Kritik wegen Menschenrechtsverletzungen in dem Konflikt zwischen Israel und den Palästinensern sowie der Kritik an dieser widerwärtigen öffentlichen Exekution zu, die stattgefunden hat.
ilsp.judge: Of course, Mr President, I agree with the criticism of China over Tibet, of Russia over Chechnya, the criticism over human rights violations in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, and the criticism of that disgusting public execution which has taken place.
ilsp.proxy: Of course, Mr. President, I agree with the criticism of China over Tibet, of Russia over Chechnya, the criticism over human rights violations in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, and the criticism of this detestable public execution that took place.
ilsp.reference: Of course, Mr. President, I concur with the criticism of China regarding Tibet, of Russia regarding Chechnya, the criticism of human rights abuses in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, as well as the criticism of this repulsive public execution that took place.

ilsp.query: Zum Beispiel zeichnet Schweden seit vielen Jahren auf der Vollversammlung der UN für eine Resolution zur Lage in Birma/Myanmar verantwortlich und die Union ist im Hinblick auf die Tatsache, dass es in Birma immer noch Zwangsarbeit gibt, als Ganzes aktiv an Gesprächen im Rahmen der Internationalen Arbeitsorganisation, ILO, engagiert.
ilsp.judge: For example, Sweden has for many years been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly and the Union as a whole is actively engaged in discussions within the International Labour Organisation, ILO, in view of the fact that there is still forced labour in Burma.
ilsp.proxy: For example, Sweden has been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly for many years, and the Union is actively engaged in talks within the framework of the International Labour Organization, ILO, taking into account the fact that forced labour still exists in Burma.
ilsp.reference: For example, Sweden has for many years been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly, and the Union as a whole is actively engaged in discussions within the International Labour Organization, ILO, in view of the fact that forced labour still exists in Burma.

ilsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
ilsp.judge: (Applause) Second: We call on you to set up a conference quite soon - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under Belgian presidency - which is based on the methodology and the model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and of course the national governments, but above all also the Commission.
ilsp.proxy: (Applause) Secondly, we call on you to start preparations quite quickly - under your presidency, they should lead to a decision in Laken under Belgian presidency - to convene a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, above all, however, also the Commission.
ilsp.reference: (Applause) Secondly: We urge you to set up a conference, fairly quickly - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under Belgian presidency - which is based on the methodology and the model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but above all also the Commission.

ilsp.query: Es gibt einen anderen Tippfehler: Tschechien und Ungarn, die die gleiche Bevölkerungszahl haben wie Belgien und Portugal, sollen nur 20 Europaabgeordnete haben, die anderen beiden Länder 22. Geben wir auch Tschechien und Ungarn 22 Abgeordnete im Europäischen Parlament und beginnen wir die Erweiterung nicht mit einer Diskriminierung dieser beiden Länder!
ilsp.judge: There is another typo: the Czech Republic and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, are to have only 20 MEPs, the other two countries 22. Let us also give the Czech Republic and Hungary 22 MEPs in the European Parliament and let us not start the enlargement with a discrimination of these two countries!
ilsp.proxy: There is another typo: Czechia and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, should only have 20 European representatives, while the other two countries have 22. Let's also give Czechia and Hungary 22 representatives in the European Parliament and start the expansion without discriminating against these two countries!
ilsp.reference: There is another typo: the Czech Republic and Hungary, which have the same population as Belgium and Portugal, are supposed to have only 20 MEPs, the other two countries 22. Let's also give the Czech Republic and Hungary 22 MEPs in the European Parliament and not start the expansion with discrimination against these two countries!

ilsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
ilsp.judge: We are very concerned that, also through the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers there are some barriers, that one does not want to give information either to the Commission or to the European Parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Council Secretariat - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some exclusions at the top of the Council Secretariat, that one does not want to give information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.
ilsp.reference: We are deeply concerned to see that, also due to the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council, there are certain barriers, in that one is unwilling to provide either the Commission or the European Parliament with information.

ilsp.query: Schweden übernimmt zum ersten Mal den Ratsvorsitz und hat seine Prioritäten gesetzt, die berühmten 3 "E ", die mit dem Manifest der europäischen Sozialisten und Sozialdemokraten übereinstimmen, weil ich stolz sagen kann, dass Herr Persson und seine Partei zu meiner politischen Familie gehören, und der Ministerpräsident Schwedens hier darüber hinaus eine Verteidigung des europäischen Sozialmodells und seiner Anpassungsfähigkeit in Zeiten der Globalisierung vorgenommen hat, die uns mit Stolz erfüllt.
ilsp.judge: Sweden takes over the presidency of the Council for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E"s, which coincide with the manifesto of the European socialists and social democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has gone beyond that here to make a defence of the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalisation which fills us with pride.
ilsp.proxy: Sweden takes over the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous 3 "E's", which align with the Manifesto of European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I am proud to say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has, in addition, made a defence of the European Social Model and its adaptability in times of Globalization, which fills us with pride.
ilsp.reference: Sweden is taking over the presidency of the Council for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous three "E"s, which are in line with the manifesto of European socialists and social democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has also made a defence of the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalisation, which fills us with pride.

ilsp.query: Das nächste Thema, das die schwedische Präsidentschaft und das uns alle vom soeben begonnenen Jahr 2001 bis zum Jahr 2004 beschäftigen wird - das sind vier Jahre mit vielen Wahlen, einschließlich der europäischen - ist das Thema "Post-Nizza".
ilsp.judge: The next issue that will occupy the Swedish Presidency and all of us from the year 2001 just begun until the year 2004 - that is four years with many elections, including the European ones - is the issue of "Post-Nice".
ilsp.proxy: The next topic that will occupy the Swedish presidency and us all from the recently begun year 2001 until the year 2004 - that are four years with many elections, including the European ones - is the topic "Post-Nice".
ilsp.reference: The next topic that will occupy the Swedish Presidency and all of us from the year 2001, which has just begun, until 2004 - that is four years with many elections, including the European ones - is the topic "Post-Nice".

ilsp.query: Erst auf dieser Grundlage sollte ein Konvent unter Beteiligung von Verfassungsexperten, Europarechtsexperten, Vertretern der nationalen Parlamente, des Europäischen Parlaments, nationaler Regierungen, aber auch der Regierungen der Beitrittsländer und natürlich des Gerichtshofs und der Zivilgesellschaft einberufen und mit der Erstellung eines Vorschlages für einen Katalog beauftragt werden, und zwar etwa bis Frühjahr 2003.
ilsp.judge: Only on this basis should a convention be convened with the participation of constitutional experts, European law experts, representatives of national parliaments, the European Parliament, national governments, but also the governments of the accession countries and of course the Court of Justice and civil society, and be tasked with drawing up a proposal for a catalogue, for example by spring 2003.
ilsp.proxy: Only on this basis should a convention be convened, involving constitutional experts, European law experts, representatives of national parliaments, the European Parliament, national governments, but also the governments of the accession countries and, of course, the Court of Justice and civil society, and be tasked with the creation of a proposal for a catalogue, roughly by spring 2003.

ilsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
ilsp.judge: If you succeed in convincing your compatriots that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability externally is also getting better and better, if you can convince them to carry this great work of European integration, you are also contributing to the fact that this area of the European Union can also be better understood by the citizens.
ilsp.proxy: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.
ilsp.reference: If you succeed in convincing your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its external stability is also constantly improving, if you can convince them to support this major work of European integration, you will also contribute to this area of the European Union being better understood by its citizens.

ilsp.query: Gleichzeitig verkündet der Europarat, dass die Folter weiterhin in den Polizeirevieren der Türkei an der Tagesordnung ist, und Amnesty International verurteilt die Folter, die Nichtbestrafung der Verantwortlichen und generell die Verstöße gegen die Menschenrechte seitens der Türkei und fordert die Europäische Union auf, zu verlangen, dass die Folter unverzüglich eingestellt wird, und nicht erst 2002­2003, wie in dem Verfahren für den Beitritt der Türkei zur Europäischen Union vorgesehen.
ilsp.judge: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still a daily occurrence in the police stations of Turkey, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible and generally the violations of human rights by Turkey and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not only in 2002-2003, as provided for in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.
ilsp.proxy:
# English
At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still on the agenda in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the non-prosecution of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and demands that the European Union call for torture to be immediately stopped, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession procedure for Turkey's entry into the European Union.
ilsp.reference: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still a daily occurrence in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and the general human rights violations by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte jedoch noch einige weiterführende Fragen stellen: Es geht mir um die de facto existierende politische Union zwischen Weißrussland und Polen sowie die Frage, inwieweit die schwedische Ratspräsidentschaft bereit ist, auch auf Russland Druck auszuüben, das ebenfalls Teil einer politischen Union mit Weißrussland ist. Inwieweit erkennt sie die Folgen für die Demokratie und die Stellung Russlands in der Weltgemeinschaft, die durch die Union mit einem Land erwachsen, das wohl kaum als Demokratie zu bezeichnen ist?
ilsp.judge: However, I would like to ask some further questions: I am concerned about the de facto political union between Belarus and Poland, and the question of how far the Swedish Presidency is prepared to put pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it recognise the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the world community, which arise from the union with a country which can hardly be described as a democracy?
ilsp.proxy: I would like to pose some further questions, however: It's about the de facto existing political union between Belarus and Poland, as well as the question of how far the Swedish presidency is willing to exert pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it acknowledge the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the international community, which arise from the union with a country that can hardly be described as a democracy?
ilsp.reference: I would, however, like to ask a few more in-depth questions: I am concerned about the de facto existing political union between Belarus and Poland, as well as the question of to what extent the Swedish Presidency of the Council is willing to also exert pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it recognize the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the international community that arise from the union with a country that can hardly be described as a democracy?

ilsp.query: Die Union hat u. a. auf der letzten Ministerratstagung der ASEAN-Staaten in Vientiane im Dezember 2000 ihre Erwartung deutlich gemacht, dass die EU-Troika die gleichen Möglichkeiten der Kontaktaufnahme zu allen beteiligten Parteien erhält, seien es nun Vertreter der Regierung, der National League for Democracy oder ethnischer Minderheiten.
ilsp.judge: The Union has, inter alia, made it clear at the last ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Vientiane in December 2000 that it expects the EU Troika to have the same opportunities to contact all parties involved, whether they are representatives of the government, the National League for Democracy or ethnic minorities.
ilsp.proxy: The Union has, inter alia, made it clear at the last ASEAN ministerial meeting in Vientiane in December 2000 that the EU Troika should have the same opportunities for contact with all parties involved, whether they be representatives of the government, the National League for Democracy, or ethnic minorities.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, Mr Simpson, Commissioner! Having just seen the news, I had hoped - and indeed it almost looked as if we were going to have a debate on fox hunting, which will undoubtedly be the subject of a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I had hoped - and it actually seemed almost like it - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament tonight.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, Mr Simpson, Commissioner! Having just watched the news, I had hoped - and it almost seemed that way - that we would be having a discussion on fox hunting, on which there will undoubtedly be a most lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, Mr Simpson has really produced an excellent report. I can say that because I am probably one of the few who are not only politically but also technically familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my activity as a Member of this Parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has really presented an excellent report. I can say that because I probably belong to the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my activity as a member of this parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, Mr Simpson has indeed submitted an excellent report. I can claim this because I am probably one of the few who are not only politically but also technically familiar with this sector, as before I took up my duties as a Member of this Parliament, I had completed around 10,000 hours of flying as a member of a cockpit crew.

ilsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
ilsp.judge: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains, the crews, are so rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.
ilsp.proxy: Either the parties will agree by May, or we expect the commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it's not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are so well-rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.
ilsp.reference: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether captains and crews are rested enough to perform their duties, is not regulated.

ilsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
ilsp.judge: Based on this, the amendment to the existing regulation proposed by us has a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims at further harmonisation of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to harmonisation of the operating requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the Community to process the variants and exceptions that Member States must apply from time to time for operational reasons.
ilsp.proxy:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.
ilsp.reference: Based on this, the amendment we propose to the existing regulation has a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims to further harmonise the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonisation of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that will enable the Community to process the variants and exemptions that Member States must apply from time to time for operational reasons.

ilsp.query: Die Änderungsanträge 9 und 10 können unverändert akzeptiert werden, die Änderungsanträge 6, 7, 8 und 11 müssten allerdings in ihrer Fassung überarbeitet werden, da wir sie jetzt - wie auch die Änderungsanträge 12, 13 und 17 - nur prinzipiell und mit einer Überarbeitung akzeptieren.
ilsp.judge: Amendments 9 and 10 can be accepted unchanged, but amendments 6, 7, 8 and 11 would have to be redrafted in their wording, as we can now only accept them in principle and with a redrafting - as well as amendments 12, 13 and 17.
ilsp.proxy: Proposals 9 and 10 can be accepted unchanged, however, proposals 6, 7, 8, and 11 would need to be revised in their current form, as we can only accept them in principle with a revision, just like proposals 12, 13, and 17.
ilsp.reference: Amendments 9 and 10 can be accepted unchanged, while amendments 6, 7, 8, and 11 would have to be revised in their wording, as we can now only accept them in principle and with revisions, just like amendments 12, 13, and 17.

ilsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
ilsp.judge: Let us make regulations, let us seek a greater degree of harmonization, let us promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic sensible and safe, and let us seek formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in built-up areas; let us harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the Member States from their lethargy.
ilsp.proxy: Let's create regulations, seek a higher degree of harmonization, promote measures to reasonably and safely arrange pedestrian and bicycle traffic, and seek formulas to reduce heavy traffic, at least in local communities; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legislative framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the member states from their lethargy.
ilsp.reference: Let us establish regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonisation, promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic reasonable and safe, and seek formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in towns; let us harmonise speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by rousing the Member States from their inertia.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Straßenverkehrssicherheit kann und muss sowohl für Europa insgesamt als auch für jedes einzelne Land eine Priorität darstellen. Deshalb stimme ich auch dem Vorschlag von Frau Hedkvist Petersen - die ich mir an dieser Stelle zu ihrem Bericht zu beglückwünschen erlaube - zu, einen strategischen Plan für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit zu entwerfen und eine Reihe strikter, aber auch realistischer quantitativer Ziele festzulegen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Mrs Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - and I would like to congratulate her on her report - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and to set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That's why I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a series of strict, but also realistic, quantitative targets.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Ms Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - and I would like to take this opportunity to congratulate her on her report - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, in erster Linie möchte ich Frau Hedkvist Petersen aufrichtig zu ihrem allumfassenden Entschließungsantrag beglückwünschen, den sie zur Sicherheit des Straßenverkehrs ausgearbeitet hat und der das Interesse des Europäischen Parlaments - das sich heute auch in Ihren Reden gezeigt hat - an einer ehrgeizigen Politik zur Bekämpfung des Übels der Verkehrsunfälle beweist.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, first of all I would like to congratulate Mrs Hedkvist Petersen most sincerely on the comprehensive resolution on road safety that she has drawn up and which demonstrates the interest of the European Parliament - as has been shown in your speeches today - in an ambitious policy to combat the evil of road accidents.
ilsp.proxy: Honourable President, first and foremost, I would like to sincerely congratulate Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen on her comprehensive resolution proposal, which she has developed for road traffic safety, and which demonstrates the European Parliament's - as has also been shown in your speeches today - interest in an ambitious policy to combat the scourge of road accidents.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, first and foremost, I would like to sincerely congratulate Ms Hedkvist Petersen on her comprehensive resolution on road safety, which demonstrates the European Parliament's interest - also evident in your speeches today - in an ambitious policy to combat the scourge of road accidents.

ilsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
ilsp.judge: If one analyzes the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be seen that the main problem points compared to traditional unimodal transport are higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality deterioration, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.proxy: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.reference: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, reduced quality, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

ilsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.
ilsp.judge: Finally, a series of obstacles, caused by the lack of harmonisation of deadlines and timetables between the various modes of transport, characterises the whole system, leading to incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: for example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not geared to intermodal operations and the terminals cannot always adapt to the 24-hour service of trains and ships.
ilsp.proxy:
# English

In the end, a series of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual modes of transport, characterizes the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not adjusted to intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.
ilsp.reference: Ultimately, a series of obstacles caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between the individual modes of transport characterize the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not coordinated with intermodal operations, and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

ilsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
ilsp.judge: In its report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had outlined the objectives to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority areas of intervention, so-called key actions, according to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport, the second interoperability and interworking, and the third the mode-independent services and regulations.
ilsp.proxy: In their report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had shown the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions, corresponding to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second the interoperability and the combined operation, and the third the transport mode-independent services and regulations.
ilsp.reference: In its report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had outlined the objectives to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority areas of intervention, so-called key actions, according to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and modes of transport, the second interoperability and coordinated operation, and the third transport mode-independent services and regulations.

ilsp.query: Ziel ist die Einrichtung eines Informationssystems, das ein Echtzeit-Verkehrsmanagement und den Einsatz elektronischer Transaktionen im Güterverkehr ermöglichen soll, und zwar durch folgende Maßnahmen: Entwicklung intermodaler elektronischer Echtzeit-Transaktions- und Informationssysteme; Harmonisierung der Kommunikationsstandards, der Verfahren und der Transportdokumente auf EDI-Grundlage; Vereinheitlichung der Haftungsregelung mit dem Ziel, dem Kunden ein klares Regelwerk transparenter Haftungsbedingungen und -verfahren für beschädigte oder unterwegs abhanden gekommene Frachten bieten zu können; Entwicklung der Technologien der Informationsgesellschaft zum Nutzen des intermodalen Verkehrs durch die Schaffung einer offenen Systemarchitektur, die eine intermodale Ortung und Laufverfolgung (tracking and tracing) ermöglicht; Ermöglichung des papierlosen Verkehrs durch Harmonisierung der vorgeschriebenen Dokumente und Entwicklung einer einzigen elektronischen Anlaufstelle.
ilsp.judge: The aim is to set up an information system that will enable real-time traffic management and the use of electronic transactions in freight transport, through the following measures: development of intermodal electronic real-time transaction and information systems; harmonisation of communication standards, procedures and transport documents on an EDI basis; standardisation of liability rules with a view to offering the customer a clear set of transparent liability conditions and procedures for damaged or lost freight in transit; development of information society technologies for the benefit of intermodal transport by creating an open system architecture that enables intermodal location and tracking; enabling paperless transport by harmonising the documents required and developing a singl
ilsp.reference: The goal is to establish an information system that will enable real-time traffic management and the use of electronic transactions in freight transport, through the following measures: development of intermodal electronic real-time transaction and information systems; harmonization of communication standards, procedures, and transport documents based on EDI; standardization of liability regulations with the aim of offering customers a clear set of transparent liability conditions and procedures for damaged or lost freight; development of information society technologies for the benefit of intermodal transport by creating an open system architecture that enables intermodal tracking and tracing; and enabling paperless transport through harmonization of required documents and development of a single electronic point

ilsp.query: Zunächst möchte ich Herrn Costa herzlich danken, der alles in allem ein enormes Pensum bewältigt hat, indem er zuerst einmal den Arbeiten - es handelt sich nämlich um einen Initiativbericht - der mit diesem Thema befassten Hochrangigen Gruppe gefolgt ist und uns dann schließlich einen Bericht vorgelegt hat, in dem wir allerdings auf jeden Fall auch noch ein anderes Signal geben wollen, insbesondere an die Adresse der Kommission.
ilsp.judge: First of all, I would like to thank Mr Costa, who has in fact dealt with an enormous amount of work, first of all by following the work - it is an initiative report - of the high-level group dealing with this subject and then finally presenting us with a report in which we certainly want to give another signal, in particular to the Commission.
ilsp.proxy: First of all, I would like to extend my warmest thanks to Mr. Costa, who has taken on an enormous workload by first following the work of the high-ranking group dealing with this topic, which is an initiative report, and then presenting us with a report in which we, however, also want to send another signal, especially to the Commission.
ilsp.reference: First of all, I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to Mr. Costa, who has managed an enormous workload by first following the work - it is, after all, an initiative report - of the high-ranking group dealing with this topic and then finally submitting a report to us, in which we also want to send a different signal, particularly to the Commission.

ilsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
ilsp.judge: If I am allowed to make a certain comparison with the discussion that is currently being conducted against the background of the problems associated with food security on the reform of agricultural policy not only in Germany but also in some other Member States - my country is one of them - I predict to you in view of today's environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transport policy.
ilsp.proxy: If a certain comparison with the discussion is allowed, which is being led in the context of food security issues in the background of the reform of agricultural policy not only in Germany, but also in some other member states - my country is among them - at present, I prophesize to you, in view of the current environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transportation policy.
ilsp.reference: If I am allowed a certain comparison with the discussion that is currently being held against the background of the problems related to food security on the reform of agricultural policy, not only in Germany but also in some other Member States - my country is among them - then, in view of today's environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - I predict a similar situation also in the field of transport policy.

ilsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
ilsp.judge: In order to avoid this, our goal must not be to minimize the costs of transport infrastructure in order to charge as little as possible, but we must provide the transport operators with a corresponding legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group that has to pay for it, namely the end users.
ilsp.proxy: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs so as to assign as few costs as possible, but rather we must provide the operators of the traffic with a corresponding legal basis, so that they can assign the costs caused by the group that is responsible for them, namely the end-users.
ilsp.reference: To avoid this, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to charge as little as possible, but rather we must provide the transport operators with a corresponding legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group that has to bear them, namely the end users.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin, auch ich möchte zunächst dem Berichterstatter meinen Dank aussprechen, und zwar nicht nur für das wirklich erhebliche Arbeitspensum, das er bewältigt hat, sondern insbesondere auch für seine Bereitschaft, die Empfehlungen, Änderungsanträge und Vorschläge aus dem gesamten Ausschuss zu übernehmen, so dass meines Erachtens von einer weitgehend kollegialen Arbeit gesprochen werden kann.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, Commissioner, I too would like to thank the rapporteur at the outset, not only for the really considerable amount of work he has done, but above all for his willingness to take on board the recommendations, amendments and proposals from the entire committee, so that, in my opinion, it can be said that there has been a largely collegial effort.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Commissioner, I would also like to express my gratitude to the rapporteur at the outset, not only for the truly considerable workload he has managed, but especially for his willingness to take on the recommendations, amendments, and proposals from the entire committee, so that, in my opinion, we can speak of a largely collegiate work.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, Commissioner, I too would like to start by expressing my thanks to the rapporteur, not only for the truly considerable amount of work he has accomplished, but also, in particular, for his willingness to take on board the recommendations, amendments and suggestions from the entire committee, so that, in my opinion, it can be said that this has been a largely collegiate effort.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
ilsp.judge: I would like to mention once again the priorities that we all share: cost allocation in a more direct relationship to the use of infrastructures; taking into account social costs, but also protecting disadvantaged areas and population groups; promoting environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcing the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to mention the points that we all have agreed on once again: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.reference: I would like to reiterate the priorities we all share: a more direct allocation of costs in relation to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, as well as protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, while at the same time enforcing the right to mobility as a universal right.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht ist gut strukturiert und stellt einen soliden Beitrag zum Verständnis der Politik der Erhebung von Infrastrukturgebühren sowie für ihre Anwendung dar. Dies ist eine Kernfrage, um der Verkehrspolitik eine Orientierung zu geben, um eine Politik zu entwickeln, die den Verkehr und eine dauerhafte Mobilität für die Zukunft gewährleistet, und um in vernünftiger Art und Weise dem außerordentlichen Bedarf Rechnung zu tragen, den wir in den nächsten Jahren bewältigen müssen.
ilsp.judge: The report is well structured and makes a solid contribution to the understanding of the policy of levying infrastructure charges as well as for their application. This is a core question to give traffic policy an orientation, to develop a policy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to take into account in a reasonable manner the extraordinary need that we have to cope with in the coming years.
ilsp.proxy: The report is well-structured and provides a solid contribution to the understanding of the policy on infrastructure charges as well as its application. This is a key issue to provide orientation to transport policy, to develop a policy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to reasonably account for the extraordinary demand that we must address in the coming years.
ilsp.reference: The report is well-structured and makes a solid contribution to understanding the policy of levying infrastructure charges and their application. This is a core issue in order to give transport policy direction, to develop a policy that ensures transport and sustainable mobility for the future, and to reasonably address the extraordinary needs that we will have to cope with in the coming years.

ilsp.query: Folglich hat die Kommission die stufenweise Einführung - ich bedauere, dass Herr Izquierdo gegangen ist, denn so hat er nicht gesehen, dass Herr Costa diesen Änderungsantrag akzeptiert hat und die Kommission damit auch zufrieden ist - eines harmonisierten Rahmens zur Erhebung von Infrastrukturgebühren in der Europäischen Union vorgeschlagen, die auf alle Verkehrsmittel anwendbar ist.
ilsp.judge: Consequently, the Commission has proposed the phased introduction - I am sorry that Mr Izquierdo has left, because he has not seen that Mr Costa has accepted this amendment and the Commission is also satisfied with it - of a harmonised framework for the collection of infrastructure charges in the European Union, which is applicable to all modes of transport.
ilsp.proxy: Consequently, the Commission has proposed a step-by-step introduction - I regret that Mr. Izquierdo has left, as he would not have seen that Mr. Costa has accepted this amendment proposal and the Commission is also satisfied with it - of a harmonized framework for the collection of infrastructure charges in the European Union, applicable to all modes of transport.
ilsp.reference: Consequently, the Commission has proposed the phased introduction - I regret that Mr Izquierdo has left, because he did not see that Mr Costa accepted this amendment and the Commission is also satisfied with it - of a harmonised framework for the levying of infrastructure charges in the European Union, applicable to all modes of transport.

ilsp.query: Heute befinden sich die Beschäftigten des Unternehmens, zumindest in Frankreich, im Streik, und ich möchte in Erwartung Ihrer Antwort hinsichtlich des Ausschusses diesen Arbeitnehmern unsere Solidarität bekunden, denn es ist eine Schande, dass ein Konzern, der Milliarden Gewinne macht, Tausende von Arbeitnehmern in ganz Europa in die Arbeitslosigkeit und ins Elend schickt.
ilsp.judge: Today, the company's employees, at least in France, are on strike, and I would like to express our solidarity with these workers in anticipation of your response regarding the committee, because it is a shame that a conglomerate that makes billions in profits is sending thousands of workers across Europe into unemployment and misery.
ilsp.proxy: Today, at least in France, the company's employees are on strike, and I would like to express our solidarity to these workers in anticipation of your response regarding the committee, because it is a shame that a conglomerate making billions in profits is sending thousands of workers across Europe into unemployment and despair.

ilsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
ilsp.judge: Mrs Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or also of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but to a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists drawn up by the parties - which are even, as you recommend in your report, drawn up as lists with a quota rule, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preference vote - constitute an excellent system for achieving a proportional representation of the parties, that is to say of the officials and candidates selected by the parties, whether women or men, in the political bodies.
ilsp.proxy: Mrs. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or also of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists that are set up by the parties - even those that, as you recommend in your report, are set up as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve a proportional representation of the parties, i.e. the officials and candidates selected by the parties, regardless of whether they are women or men, in the political organs.
ilsp.reference: Ms Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists drawn up by the parties - which, as you recommend in your report, are even drawn up as lists with a quota system, where it is no longer possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system for achieving proportional representation of the parties, i.e. of the officials and candidates selected by the parties, whether women or men, in the political bodies.

ilsp.query: Die Wirklichkeit zeigt jedoch, dass dies ungeachtet der mannigfachen Empfehlungen und Entschließungen ein Bereich ist, in dem nach wie vor größere Ungleichgewichte herrschen und Frauen in den politischen Entscheidungsgremien - sowohl im wirtschaftlichen und sozialen als auch im politischen Leben - erheblich unterrepräsentiert sind. Dies wiederum trägt dazu bei, dass die vorhandenen Ungleichheiten und Diskriminierungen weiter bestehen.
ilsp.judge: However, the reality shows that, despite the manifold recommendations and resolutions, this is an area where there are still major imbalances and women are still significantly under-represented in political decision-making bodies - both in economic and social and in political life. This in turn contributes to the perpetuation of existing inequalities and discriminations.

This, in turn, contributes to the persistence of existing inequalities and discriminations.

ilsp.query: Die doppelte Belastung durch familiäre Pflichten und Berufstätigkeit kann man meiner Meinung nach nicht als Diskriminierung bezeichnen, und sie ist auch kein zweifacher Nachteil wie in Erwägungsgrund D dargestellt. Familie und Beruf miteinander verbinden zu können, stellt eher ein hohes Maß an Organisationstalent und eine nicht zu unterschätzende Lebenserfahrung dar, die als besondere Qualifikation für Führungspersönlichkeiten gewertet werden muss.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, the double burden of family responsibilities and employment cannot be considered discrimination, and it is not a double disadvantage as described in recital D. Being able to combine family and work requires a high degree of organizational talent and a not to be underestimated life experience, which must be valued as a special qualification for leaders.
ilsp.proxy: The double burden of family obligations and professional activity cannot, in my opinion, be described as discrimination, and it is also not a double disadvantage as presented in Ground D. Being able to connect family and profession is rather a high level of organizational talent and a not to be underestimated life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leaders.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, the double burden of family responsibilities and professional activity cannot be described as discrimination, and it is not a double disadvantage as presented in Recital D. Being able to combine family and profession rather represents a high degree of organizational talent and a not-to-be-underestimated life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leaders.

ilsp.query: Da er sich aber wesentlich langsamer erneuert, müsste eine neue, eine dritte Kategorie geschaffen werden, die zwischen fossilen und schnell erneuerbaren Energiequellen liegt, das heißt die Kategorie die eines Brennstoffs mit langsamer Regeneration.
ilsp.judge: However, since it renews itself much more slowly, a new, third category should be created, which lies between fossil and fast renewable energy sources, that is, the category of a fuel with slow regeneration.

ilsp.query: Eine Reform der Schulung (beispielsweise Verkehrserziehung bereits in der Schule und Schulung in Notbremsung in der Fahrschule), die Systematisierung der aktiven und passiven Sicherheitselemente auch in einfachen Kraftfahrzeugen durch steuerliche Anreize für die Hersteller oder die Veränderung der Infrastrukturen, indem die "Unfallschwerpunkte " völlig beseitigt werden, das sind die echten Herausforderungen einer intelligenten Politik der Straßenverkehrssicherheit.
ilsp.judge: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple motor vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or the change of infrastructures by completely eliminating the "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of an intelligent policy of road safety.

ilsp.judge: This problem is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially with regard to the Alpine transversal Munich-Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be prompted by the new vote, which the Parliament has expressed here, to accelerate the corresponding preparatory work and to pursue it with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be brought to a solution.

ilsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
ilsp.judge: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a pensioner, I think it is right that I have to pay a toll for using this motorway, because in this way I am making a contribution to the construction and maintenance of motorways, which are an important transport infrastructure. But it would be good if workers who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the fee."

ilsp.query: Wenn der Kraftstoffpreis schwindelerregend hoch ist und das Fünf- bis Sechsfache dessen beträgt, was das Benzin beim Verlassen der Raffinerie kostet, weil er sich zu mehr als 80 % aus Steuern zusammensetzt, so kann man wohl sagen, dass der Straßennutzer, gemessen an der Nutzung seines Fahrzeugs, bereits in hohem Maße dafür zur Kasse gebeten wird, dass er öffentliche Straßeninfrastrukturen nutzt.
ilsp.judge: If the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times what the gasoline costs when it leaves the refinery because it consists of more than 80% taxes, then one can say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already asked to pay a high price for using public road infrastructure.

ilsp.query: Georgien wird heute buchstäblich durch seinen großen Nachbarn erstickt; das Land wird mit Öl­, Gas- und Stromlieferungen sowie mit Visavorschriften erpresst und ist dieser unglaublichen Diskriminierung zwischen den Bürgern Südossetiens und Abchasiens einerseits und den übrigen georgischen Bürgern andererseits ausgesetzt.
ilsp.judge: Georgia is literally being strangled by its big neighbor today; the country is being blackmailed with oil, gas and electricity supplies as well as visa regulations and is exposed to this incredible discrimination between the citizens of South Ossetia and Abkhazia on the one hand and the other Georgian citizens on the other.
ilsp.proxy: Georgia is literally being strangled today by its large neighbour; the country is being blackmailed with oil, gas, and electricity supplies as well as visa restrictions, and is exposed to this unbelievable discrimination between the citizens of South Ossetia and Abkhazia on the one hand and the rest of Georgian citizens on the other.

ilsp.query: Unsere Bitte an die Kommission ist deshalb, zusammen mit dem Rat zu überlegen, ob wir diese Konfliktfälle nicht besser aufarbeiten und darangehen sollten, mit Entscheidungen, die in die richtige Richtung gehen, den Menschen dort, die eine demokratische Gesellschaft aufbauen wollen und friedliche Zukunftsvisionen brauchen, zu helfen und Georgien zu unterstützen, damit es die Menschenrechte einhalten und den übrigen im Europarat eingegangenen Verpflichtungen nachkommen kann.
ilsp.judge: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider, together with the Council, whether we should not better address these conflict cases and start to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions for the future, and to support Georgia so that it can respect human rights and comply with the other commitments made in the Council of Europe.
ilsp.proxy: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider together with the Council whether we should not better process these conflict cases and proceed with decisions that are heading in the right direction, to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions of the future, and to support Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and fulfill the other obligations it has entered into within the Council of Europe.
ilsp.reference: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider, together with the Council, whether we should not better address these conflict cases and take decisions that go in the right direction to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions for the future, and to support Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and comply with the other commitments it has entered into in the Council of Europe.

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
lsp.judge: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my multiple letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that in Turkey, since October 20, that is, for months, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on a hunger strike, risking death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot implement its plan to lock them up in white single cells and thus break their morale and resistance.
lsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have already pointed out on several occasions and in my multiple letters to you, I would like to draw attention through my statement today to the fact that in Turkey, since October 20th, hundreds of political prisoners have been on hunger strike for months under inhumane conditions, even risking death—some of them have already died—in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to lock them up in white isolation cells, thereby breaking their morale and resistance.

lsp.query: Wenn wir also die Qualität von Bildung bewerten, wollen wir wissen, ob Menschen mit Selbstachtung und Vertrauen herangebildet werden, die in der Lage sind, effektiv zu kommunizieren, hinter der Meldung die versteckte Nachricht zu erkennen, Fragen zu stellen, sowohl im Team als auch selbständig zu arbeiten, kreativ und einfallsreich zu sein und sich der Welt als Ganzes und ihrer Verantwortung für sie bewusst zu sein.
lsp.judge: So when we assess the quality of education, we want to know whether people are being educated with self-respect and confidence, who are able to communicate effectively, to recognize the hidden message behind the message, to ask questions, to work both in a team and independently, to be creative and resourceful, and to be aware of the world as a whole and their responsibility for it.

lsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
lsp.judge: It has been proven that it was right to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had moved it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even one euro there.

lsp.query: Der Rechnungshof stellte in seinem Bericht fest, dass ein Rechnungsführungssystem nicht vorhanden war, was Anlass zu großer Besorgnis gab; dass es schwierig war, Projektentwicklungen einfach und zusammenhängend zurückzuverfolgen; und dass die EZB im Juli 1998 eine Beratergesellschaft mit der Durchführung von FCRS-Projekten (Foreign Currency Reserves Subledger - Nebenbuch über die Währungsreserven) beauftragt hatte, jedoch bis Ende 1998 noch immer keinen Vollzeit-Projektleiter aus ihren Reihen bestellt hatte, obwohl dies von wesentlicher Bedeutung war, um die Arbeit dieser Beratergesellschaft zu kontrollieren.
lsp.judge: The Court of Auditors stated in its report that there was no accounting system, which gave rise to great concern; that it was difficult to trace project developments simply and coherently; and that the ECB had in July 1998 commissioned a consultancy firm to carry out FCRS projects (Foreign Currency Reserves Subledger), but had still not appointed a full-time project manager from its own ranks by the end of 1998, although this was of crucial importance in order to control the work of this consultancy firm.

lsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
lsp.judge: (ES) My support for the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union which, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to the fore the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements which constitute our common cultural heritage.
lsp.proxy: My approval of the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that brings to the fore the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage, as one of the main features of its intellectual wealth and the Old Continent.
