ilsp.query: Erstens, Herrn Solana möchte ich sagen, dass, als wir 1999 zusammen mit anderen Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Erfahrung bringen wollten, ob im Kosovo abgereichertes Uran benutzt wird, sträfliches Schweigen herrschte, und Frau Wallström hat in ihrer Antwort auf eine Anfrage - ich habe hier das Protokoll vorliegen - wörtlich gesagt, noch sei nicht bestätigt, ob nicht angereichertes Uran eingesetzt worden sei.
ilsp.judge: First, Mr Solana, I would like to say that, when we were trying to find out in 1999, together with other colleagues, whether depleted uranium was being used in Kosovo, there was a guilty silence, and Mrs Wallström, in her reply to a question - I have the minutes here - said literally that it had not yet been confirmed that non-enriched uranium had been used.
ilsp.proxy: Firstly, I would like to say to Mr. Solana that when we wanted to find out in 1999, together with other colleagues, whether depleted uranium was used in Kosovo, there was a criminal silence, and in her response to a question - I have the protocol here - Mrs. Wallström said verbatim that it has not yet been confirmed whether non-enriched uranium was used.
ilsp.reference: Firstly, I would like to tell Mr. Solana that when we, along with other colleagues, wanted to find out in 1999 whether depleted uranium was being used in Kosovo, there was culpable silence, and Ms. Wallström literally said in her response to a query - I have the minutes here - that it had not yet been confirmed whether non-enriched uranium had been used.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What is happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our Member States certainly does not help to motivate young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so beautifully states, they have an important social function to fulfil by devoting themselves to the care and maintenance of the landscape and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of rural areas.
ilsp.proxy: What is happening since the rather hysterical exaggeration of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to see their future in rural areas, where, as beautifully stated in our report, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape maintenance and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of the rural area.
ilsp.reference: What has been happening in most of our Member States since the rather hysterical escalation of this crisis is certainly not helping to motivate young people to stay in agriculture, and even less so to see their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape conservation and maintenance and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
ilsp.judge: We must, also in the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the designations of origin of our quality products, including wine, because our future in the EU and what the export to third countries is concerned, lies in high-quality products, for which there are solvent and mature consumers here, and also in the world.
ilsp.proxy: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, even within the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and regarding exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are solvent and mature consumers both here and in the world.
ilsp.reference: We must also defend and secure the designations of origin of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are solvent and discerning consumers both here and around the world.

ilsp.query: Da die Gemeinschaft gemäß der einschlägigen Erklärung in Artikel 5 Absatz 1 des Anhangs IX des Internationalen Seerechtsübereinkommens allein für die Erhaltung und Bewirtschaftung der Fischbestände zuständig und damit befugt ist, die entsprechenden Regeln und Bestimmungen festzulegen, sollte die Kommission von dieser Befugnis Gebrauch machen und das ausschließliche Fangrecht auch für die griechischen Fischer auf 12 Seemeilen festlegen.
ilsp.judge: Since the Community, in accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and is therefore empowered to lay down the corresponding rules and provisions, the Commission should make use of this power and establish the exclusive fishing right also for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles.
ilsp.proxy: Since the Community, in accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5(1) of Annex IX of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and is therefore authorized to establish the relevant rules and regulations, the Commission should use this authority to set the exclusive fishing rights for Greek fishermen at 12 nautical miles as well.
ilsp.reference: Since the Community, in accordance with the relevant declaration in Article 5(1) of Annex IX to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, is solely responsible for the conservation and management of fish stocks and is therefore empowered to lay down the corresponding rules and provisions, the Commission should make use of this power and establish the exclusive fishing right, also for Greek fishermen, at 12 nautical miles.

ilsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
ilsp.judge: The joint resolution on the "Balkan syndrome" is only intended to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of defending human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
ilsp.proxy: The joint motion for resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to cover up the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which, under the pretext of defending human rights, intervened in Yugoslavia and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
ilsp.reference: The joint resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" merely serves to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights, thereby causing irreparable human and material damage.

ilsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
ilsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions to be taken when handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element when inhaled or ingested, which is also genetically dangerous.
ilsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with the Second World War, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as they are highly toxic (both chemically and radiologically) elements that can be dangerous if inhaled or ingested, and are also genetically hazardous.
ilsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.

ilsp.query: Wir alle wissen, dass diese Waffen, die von der NATO im Golfkrieg (1991), in Bosnien (1994-95) und im Kosovo (1999) eingesetzt wurden, schwerwiegende Folgen zunächst für die bombardierte Zivilbevölkerung, aber auch für die Umwelt und die Militärangehörigen der NATO, der irakischen, bosnischen, serbischen und kosovarischen Streitkräfte hatten.
ilsp.judge: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95) and in Kosovo (1999), had serious consequences first for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian and Kosovar armed forces.
ilsp.proxy: We all know that these weapons, used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95), and in Kosovo (1999), had serious consequences first for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian, and Kosovar forces.
ilsp.reference: We all know that these weapons, which were used by NATO in the Gulf War (1991), in Bosnia (1994-95), and in Kosovo (1999), had severe consequences initially for the bombed civilian population, but also for the environment and the military personnel of NATO, the Iraqi, Bosnian, Serbian, and Kosovar forces.

ilsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
ilsp.judge: I have also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American and Russian spies.
ilsp.proxy: I have also observed with concern over the past year that the current Russian leadership, which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself formerly a KGB colonel, has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
ilsp.reference: I also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a former KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

ilsp.query: Aus diesem Grund müssen sich der Rat und die Mitgliedstaaten für die universelle Ratifizierung der wichtigsten Menschenrechtsinstrumente einsetzen, die allen Ländern zur Verfügung stehen. Dazu zählen insbesondere der Internationale Pakt über bürgerliche und politische Rechte, der Internationale Pakt über wirtschaftliche, soziale und kulturelle Rechte, das Übereinkommen zur Beseitigung jeder Form von Diskriminierung der Frau, das bereits erwähnte Übereinkommen über die Rechte des Kindes, das Internationale Übereinkommen zur Beseitigung jeder Form von Rassendiskriminierung und das überaus wichtige Übereinkommen zur Verhütung von Folter und unmenschlicher oder erniedrigender Behandlung oder Strafe.
ilsp.judge: For this reason, the Council and the Member States must work for the universal ratification of the key human rights instruments available to all countries. These include in particular the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the aforementioned Convention on the Rights of the Child, the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination and the extremely important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.
ilsp.proxy: For this reason, the Council and the Member States must strive for the universal ratification of the key human rights instruments that are available to all countries. These include, in particular, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women, the already mentioned Convention on the Rights of the Child, the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination, and the extremely important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.
ilsp.reference: For this reason, the Council and the Member States must work towards the universal ratification of the key human rights instruments available to all countries. These include, in particular, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the aforementioned Convention on the Rights of the Child, the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination, and the highly important Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.

ilsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
ilsp.judge: We are very concerned that, also through the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers there are some barriers, that one does not want to give information either to the Commission or to the European Parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We observe with great concern that there are some barriers at the top of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers, also due to the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr. Solana, whom I hold in high regard, is more concerned with the task of the High Representative - in that they are unwilling to provide information either to the Commission or to the European Parliament.
ilsp.reference: We are deeply concerned to see that, also due to the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council, there are certain barriers, in that one is unwilling to provide either the Commission or the European Parliament with information.

ilsp.query: Was die in Genf ansässige UN-Kommission zur Durchsetzung von Entschädigungsforderungen betrifft, die ja seit Beendigung des Golfkrieges mit der Begleichung von aus diesem Krieg stammenden Forderungen beschäftigt ist, so halte ich es für klug, eine Untersuchung der UNO über eine Fortsetzung der Arbeit dieser Kommission abzuwarten, ehe die Union dazu Stellung nimmt.
ilsp.judge: As regards the Geneva-based UN Compensation Commission, which has been dealing with claims arising from the Gulf War since the end of the Gulf War, I think it would be wise to wait for a UN investigation into the continuation of the work of this Commission before the Union takes a position on it.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the UN Commission based in Geneva, which has been dealing with the settlement of claims since the end of the Gulf War, I believe it is wise to await a UN investigation into the continuation of this commission's work before the Union takes a position.
ilsp.reference: As for the UN Commission based in Geneva, which has been dealing with settling claims arising from the Gulf War since its end, I think it would be wise to wait for a UN investigation into the continuation of this Commission's work before the Union takes a position.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, Mr Simpson, Commissioner! Having just seen the news, I had hoped - and indeed it almost looked as if we were going to have a debate on fox hunting, which will undoubtedly be the subject of a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Madam Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I hoped - and it actually looked that way too - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, Mr Simpson, Commissioner! Having just watched the news, I had hoped - and it almost seemed that way - that we would be having a discussion on fox hunting, on which there will undoubtedly be a most lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.

ilsp.query: Abschließend, Herr Präsident, verweise ich auf die Notwendigkeit, der Kommission bei ihrer Arbeit auf diesem so komplizierten Gebiet zu helfen, und auf die Priorität der Schaffung der Europäischen Luftverkehrssicherheitsbehörde sowie auf die dringend erforderliche selbstständige Vorschrift zu den Fragen der Ruhezeiten für die Besatzungen, die wir im Moment behandeln.
ilsp.judge: Finally, Mr President, I would like to refer to the need to help the Commission in its work in this very complex area, and to the priority of creating the European Aviation Safety Agency, as well as to the urgent need for an independent regulation on the issue of rest periods for crews, which we are currently dealing with.
ilsp.proxy: In conclusion, Mr. President, I would like to refer to the necessity of assisting the Commission in its work in this highly complex area, and to the priority of establishing the European Aviation Safety Agency, as well as the urgently needed independent regulation on the issue of crew rest periods, which we are currently addressing.
ilsp.reference: In conclusion, Mr President, I would like to stress the need to assist the Commission in its work in this highly complex field, the priority of establishing the European Aviation Safety Agency and the urgent need for an independent regulation on the issue of rest periods for crews, which we are currently addressing.

ilsp.query: Die Änderungsanträge 9 und 10 können unverändert akzeptiert werden, die Änderungsanträge 6, 7, 8 und 11 müssten allerdings in ihrer Fassung überarbeitet werden, da wir sie jetzt - wie auch die Änderungsanträge 12, 13 und 17 - nur prinzipiell und mit einer Überarbeitung akzeptieren.
ilsp.judge: Amendments 9 and 10 can be accepted unchanged, but amendments 6, 7, 8 and 11 would have to be redrafted in their wording, as we can now only accept them in principle and with a redrafting - as well as amendments 12, 13 and 17.
ilsp.proxy: Amendments 9 and 10 can be accepted without change, but amendments 6, 7, 8, and 11 would need to be revised in their formulation, as we now accept them - like amendments 12, 13, and 17 - only in principle and with revision.
ilsp.reference: Amendments 9 and 10 can be accepted unchanged, while amendments 6, 7, 8, and 11 would have to be revised in their wording, as we can now only accept them in principle and with revisions, just like amendments 12, 13, and 17.

ilsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
ilsp.judge: Let us make regulations, let us seek a greater degree of harmonization, let us promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic sensible and safe, and let us seek formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in built-up areas; let us harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the Member States from their lethargy.
ilsp.proxy: When we establish regulations, we seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to make pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonable and safe, and look for formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in urban areas; we harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.
ilsp.reference: Let us establish regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonisation, promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic reasonable and safe, and seek formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in towns; let us harmonise speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by rousing the Member States from their inertia.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Straßenverkehrssicherheit kann und muss sowohl für Europa insgesamt als auch für jedes einzelne Land eine Priorität darstellen. Deshalb stimme ich auch dem Vorschlag von Frau Hedkvist Petersen - die ich mir an dieser Stelle zu ihrem Bericht zu beglückwünschen erlaube - zu, einen strategischen Plan für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit zu entwerfen und eine Reihe strikter, aber auch realistischer quantitativer Ziele festzulegen.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Mrs Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - and I would like to congratulate her on her report - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and to set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority for Europe as a whole as well as for each individual country. Therefore, I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to design a strategic plan for road safety and to set a series of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Ms Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - and I would like to take this opportunity to congratulate her on her report - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative targets.

ilsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
ilsp.judge: If one analyzes the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be seen that the main problem points compared to traditional unimodal transport are higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality deterioration, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.proxy: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be observed that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances traveled by goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
ilsp.reference: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, reduced quality, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

ilsp.query: Der nächste Schritt muss darin bestehen, dass man in Erwägung zieht, in den Fällen, wo die Anlastung einiger dieser Kosten keinen Sinn mehr hätte - ich denke dabei an die italienischen Autobahnen, die sich weitgehend amortisiert haben -, mit diesen heute existierenden Gebühren Fonds zu bilden, die möglicherweise für Quersubventionen genutzt werden könnten, um zu erreichen, dass bestimmte den Straßenbenutzern auferlegte Gebühren für die Verbesserung der Infrastruktur anderer, mit Sicherheit umweltverträglicherer Verkehrsträger verwendet werden.
ilsp.judge: The next step must be to consider, in cases where the allocation of some of these costs would no longer make sense - I am thinking of the Italian motorways, which are largely amortised - to set up funds with these existing charges which could possibly be used for cross-subsidies in order to achieve the use of certain charges imposed on road users for the improvement of the infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly, modes of transport.
ilsp.proxy: The next step must be to consider, in cases where charging for some of these costs no longer makes sense - I am thinking here of the Italian motorways, which have been largely amortized -, using these existing charges to form funds that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to achieve that certain fees imposed on road users for the improvement of infrastructure are used for other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport.
ilsp.reference: The next step must be to consider, in cases where charging some of these costs would no longer make sense - I am thinking here of the Italian motorways, which have largely been amortized - forming funds from these existing tolls that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to achieve that certain charges imposed on road users are used for the improvement of the infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, Frau Kommissarin, auch ich möchte zunächst dem Berichterstatter meinen Dank aussprechen, und zwar nicht nur für das wirklich erhebliche Arbeitspensum, das er bewältigt hat, sondern insbesondere auch für seine Bereitschaft, die Empfehlungen, Änderungsanträge und Vorschläge aus dem gesamten Ausschuss zu übernehmen, so dass meines Erachtens von einer weitgehend kollegialen Arbeit gesprochen werden kann.
ilsp.judge: Mr President, Commissioner, I too would like to thank the rapporteur at the outset, not only for the really considerable amount of work he has done, but above all for his willingness to take on board the recommendations, amendments and proposals from the entire committee, so that, in my opinion, it can be said that there has been a largely collegial effort.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, Madam Commissioner, I too would like to thank the rapporteur, not only for the truly considerable amount of work he has accomplished, but also particularly for his willingness to adopt recommendations, amendments, and suggestions from the entire committee, so that I believe we can speak of a largely collegial effort.
ilsp.reference: Mr President, Commissioner, I too would like to start by expressing my thanks to the rapporteur, not only for the truly considerable amount of work he has accomplished, but also, in particular, for his willingness to take on board the recommendations, amendments and suggestions from the entire committee, so that, in my opinion, it can be said that this has been a largely collegiate effort.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
ilsp.judge: I would like to mention once again the priorities that we all share: cost allocation in a more direct relationship to the use of infrastructures; taking into account social costs, but also protecting disadvantaged areas and population groups; promoting environmental compatibility, but at the same time also enforcing the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to restate the key points we all share: cost distribution in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructures; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.
ilsp.reference: I would like to reiterate the priorities we all share: a more direct allocation of costs in relation to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, as well as protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, while at the same time enforcing the right to mobility as a universal right.

ilsp.query: Diese Frage der Gebührengestaltung ist also von absolut zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn wir wirklich die gewünschte Verkehrsverlagerung erreichen wollen, müssen wir daher den Mut aufbringen, effektiv eine Internalisierung der externen Kosten herbeizuführen, d. h. dass im Straßenverkehr das bezahlt wird, was er wirklich kostet, dass im Eisenbahnverkehr bezahlt wird, was er kostet und dass die Kostenklarheit zur Preiswahrheit führt.
ilsp.judge: This question of tariff design is therefore of absolutely central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired modal shift, we must therefore have the courage to effectively internalize the external costs, i.e. that in road traffic what it really costs is paid, that in rail traffic what it costs is paid and that the cost clarity leads to price truth.
ilsp.proxy: This issue of fee structuring is therefore of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired shift in traffic, we must have the courage to effectively bring about the internalization of external costs, i.e., that in road traffic, what it really costs is paid, that in rail traffic, what it costs is paid, and that cost transparency leads to price truth.
ilsp.reference: This issue of toll design is therefore of absolute central importance. If we really want to achieve the desired shift in traffic, we must therefore muster the courage to effectively bring about an internalization of external costs, i.e. that road traffic pays what it really costs, that rail traffic pays what it costs, and that cost transparency leads to price truth.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht ist gut strukturiert und stellt einen soliden Beitrag zum Verständnis der Politik der Erhebung von Infrastrukturgebühren sowie für ihre Anwendung dar. Dies ist eine Kernfrage, um der Verkehrspolitik eine Orientierung zu geben, um eine Politik zu entwickeln, die den Verkehr und eine dauerhafte Mobilität für die Zukunft gewährleistet, und um in vernünftiger Art und Weise dem außerordentlichen Bedarf Rechnung zu tragen, den wir in den nächsten Jahren bewältigen müssen.
ilsp.judge: The report is well structured and makes a solid contribution to the understanding of the policy of levying infrastructure charges as well as for their application. This is a core question to give traffic policy an orientation, to develop a policy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to take into account in a reasonable manner the extraordinary need that we have to cope with in the coming years.
ilsp.proxy: The report is well-structured and represents a solid contribution to understanding the policy of charging infrastructure fees as well as their application. This is a core issue to guide traffic policy in developing a strategy that ensures traffic and sustainable mobility for the future, and to address the extraordinary needs we must tackle in the coming years in a reasonable manner.
ilsp.reference: The report is well-structured and makes a solid contribution to understanding the policy of levying infrastructure charges and their application. This is a core issue in order to give transport policy direction, to develop a policy that ensures transport and sustainable mobility for the future, and to reasonably address the extraordinary needs that we will have to cope with in the coming years.

ilsp.query: In diesen Berichten wiederholen wir uns ständig. Wir fordern bessere Statistiken und Ausbildung, Aufklärungskampagnen, um mehr Frauen für die Politik zu interessieren, so wie sie bereits sehr oft in ihren eigenen Gemeinden und örtlichen Gruppen eine wichtige Rolle spielen, und wir fordern Maßnahmen, damit Männer und Frauen Arbeit und Familie besser in Einklang bringen können.
ilsp.judge: In these reports we repeat ourselves constantly. We call for better statistics and training, awareness campaigns to interest more women in politics, as they already play an important role in their own communities and local groups, and we call for measures to help men and women reconcile work and family life better.
ilsp.proxy: In these reports, we constantly repeat ourselves. ilsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
ilsp.judge: Mrs Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or also of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but to a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists drawn up by the parties - which are even, as you recommend in your report, drawn up as lists with a quota rule, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preference vote - constitute an excellent system for achieving a proportional representation of the parties, that is to say of the officials and candidates selected by the parties, whether women or men, in the political bodies.
ilsp.proxy: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the underrepresentation of women or also young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democratic deficit, and the electoral lists drawn up by the parties - which, as you recommend in your report, should even be compiled as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve a proportional representation of the parties, i.e., the officials and candidates selected by the parties, whether women or men, in political bodies.

ilsp.query: Jene, die darauf setzen, dass die formelle Gleichstellung, der Faktor Zeit und die selbstregulierenden Mechanismen quasi von selbst ein soziales Gleichgewicht herstellen, irren. Sicher sind die Gleichstellung vor dem Gesetz und die Chancengleichheit unerlässliche Voraussetzungen, doch dabei dürfen wir es nicht belassen.
ilsp.judge: Those who bet that formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms will quasi-automatically establish a social balance are mistaken. Certainly, equality before the law and equal opportunity are essential prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.proxy: Those who bet on formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to almost automatically establish a social balance are mistaken. Certainly, equality before the law and equal opportunities are indispensable prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.reference: Those who rely on formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to more or less automatically establish social equilibrium are mistaken. Certainly, equality before the law and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, but we must not stop there.

ilsp.query: Diese Problematik ist für den Alpenbereich - und ich komme ja aus dem Alpenbereich - und vor allem in Bezug auf die Alpentransversale München-Verona von ganz besonderer Bedeutung, und wir hoffen, dass sich die Kommission durch das neuerliche Votum, das das Parlament hier zum Ausdruck gebracht hat, veranlasst sieht, die entsprechenden Vorbereitungsarbeiten noch zu beschleunigen und mit viel größerer Konzentration und Stärke voranzutreiben, als es bisher erfolgt ist, damit dieses dringende Problem im Alpenbereich einer Lösung zugeführt werden kann.
ilsp.judge: This problem is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially with regard to the Alpine transversal Munich-Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be prompted by the new vote, which the Parliament has expressed here, to accelerate the corresponding preparatory work and to pursue it with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be brought to a solution.

ilsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
ilsp.judge: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a pensioner, I think it is right that I have to pay a toll for using this motorway, because in this way I am making a contribution to the construction and maintenance of motorways, which are an important transport infrastructure. But it would be good if workers who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the fee."
